Administrator user must exist to validate updated user-role association.
Role entity must exist before assigning it to users in updated user role associations.

operations.specification: This operation permanently removes a user role assignment record by its unique identifier from the shopping mall platform. The record represents the mapping of a user (administrator) to a specific role, controlling access rights and permissions. The deletion is a hard delete removing the record entirely without soft delete features.
operations.description:
This DELETE operation removes the specified shopping mall user role mapping identified by its unique ID. It is used when an administrator's role needs to be revoked or adjusted. 

Security considerations: Only authorized admin users should perform this operation to prevent unauthorized permission changes. 

Related operations include creating roles, listing user roles, and managing role permissions.

The deletion is permanent and does not support soft deletion or recovery.
operations.summary: Delete a shopping mall user role mapping by ID

parameters.name: shoppingMallUserRoleId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the shopping mall user role mapping to delete

operations.name: erase

prerequisites.description: User role mapping must be created before it can be deleted to ensure the mapping exists.
Role definitions must exist before assigning roles to users, ensuring valid role references.

operations.specification:
This operation retrieves a paginated list of shopping mall permissions with advanced filtering capabilities. Each permission entry defines granular access rights within the platform's administrative backend, including unique names, labels, and detailed descriptions.

The operation supports search, pagination, and sorting to efficiently manage permissions.
operations.description:
Retrieve a filtered and paginated list of shopping mall permissions from the system. The permissions define what actions administrators can perform within the shopping mall platform. 

This supports efficient permission management, allowing administrators to find specific permissions based on name, label, or description.

Security considerations: Access restricted to authorized administrative users only. 

Related operations include creating permissions, updating roles, and managing user role assignments.
operations.summary: Search and retrieve a paginated list of shopping mall permissions

requestBody.description: Search criteria and pagination parameters for permission filtering

responseBody.description: Paginated list of shopping mall permission summary information matching search criteria

operations.name: index

prerequisites.description: Permissions must be created before they can be listed or managed to guarantee valid permission data.

operations.specification: This operation retrieves a shopping mall permission entity by its unique name from the shopping_mall_permissions table. It returns the detailed permission including the unique permission name, human-readable label, and an optional detailed description. The API serves as a read-only access point for clients or administrative users to fetch permission details for authorization checks or management interfaces.
operations.summary: Retrieve a shopping mall permission by its unique name
operations.description:
This operation allows clients to fetch detailed information about a specific shopping mall permission identified by its unique name.

The response includes the permission's unique internal name, its human-readable label, and an optional detailed description explaining its scope and usage within the shopping platform.

Security: Access to this endpoint should be carefully controlled, usually allowing only administrative or authorization service actors to ensure permission data integrity.

Parameters:
- `name`: The unique permission identifier used internally in the system.

This operation is fundamental for implementing fine-grained access controls and is typically used in conjunction with role or user permission assignment APIs.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Unique permission identifier name of the target shopping mall permission (global scope)

responseBody.description: Detailed information of the requested shopping mall permission

operations.name: at

prerequisites.description: A shopping mall permission must be created before it can be retrieved by name.

operations.specification:
This operation creates a new shopping mall permission record in the shopping_mall_permissions table. The created permission must have a unique internal name, a human-readable label, and optionally a detailed description to clarify its usage.

This API endpoint is used by system administrators to add new permission identifiers that can be assigned to roles or individual users for controlling access rights across the platform.

Security: Only authorized administrators should be allowed to invoke this operation, as creating new permissions affects the entire system's access control structure.

The creation operation automatically timestamps when the permission was created and updated.
operations.summary: Create a new shopping mall permission
operations.description:
Creates a new permission entity within the shopping mall backend system. This permission defines a specific access right that can be assigned to users or roles.

The operation requires the unique permission `name`, a display `label`, and optionally a comprehensive `description` to explain the permission's purpose.

Security and validation ensure that permission names are unique and conform to naming conventions.

On success, the newly created permission object is returned.

Use this API to manage granular access control policies dynamically within the platform.

requestBody.description: The permission information to create

responseBody.description: The created shopping mall permission entity

operations.name: create

operations.specification: This operation updates an existing permission entry in the shopping_mall_permissions table identified uniquely by its "name" field. It modifies fields such as label and description while ensuring the unique name identifier remains intact. It provides authorized administrators the capability to manage permission definitions controlling access rights in the shopping mall backend.
operations.description:
Update a specific shopping mall permission, identified by its unique 'name'. The operation allows changing the label and detailed description of the permission to reflect changes in access control policies.

Only administrators have permissions to execute this operation to maintain security and consistency of access rights across the platform.

The response returns the updated permission entity with all details after modification.

Related operations include deleting permissions via DELETE method on the same path to remove obsolete entries.
operations.summary: Update a shopping mall permission by unique name

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Unique permission identifier for internal use

requestBody.description: Updated permission information

responseBody.description: Updated permission entity

operations.name: update

prerequisites.description: Permission must be created before it can be updated by unique name.

operations.specification:
This operation deletes a permission entry from the shopping_mall_permissions table uniquely identified by its 'name' field. The operation permanently removes the targeted permission and all its associated metadata.

Due to its critical impact on access control, only administrators are authorized to perform deletions.

This operation complements the update operation used for modifying permission definitions and is vital for managing the lifecycle of permissions within the shopping mall platform.
operations.description:
Delete a specific shopping mall permission by its unique name.

This operation permanently removes the permission entry from the database and revokes its availability for role or user assignment.

Only administrators are authorized to execute this operation to protect system security.

The deletion is irreversible and requires caution due to its potential impact on access policies.
operations.summary: Delete a shopping mall permission by unique name

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Unique permission identifier for internal use

operations.name: erase

prerequisites.description: Permission must exist before it can be deleted by unique name.

operations.specification: This operation retrieves a paginated list of administrator audit log entries for the shopping mall backend platform. It accesses the shopping_mall_admin_audit_logs snapshot table, which contains immutable records of admin actions for security, compliance, and traceability purposes. The operation supports complex filtering, search criteria, sorting, and pagination to allow administrators to efficiently navigate audit records.
operations.summary: Search and retrieve admin audit logs with filtering and pagination
operations.description:
Retrieve a filtered and paginated list of administrator audit logs from the shopping mall platform. This operation supports advanced search criteria allowing administrators to filter logs based on action types, timestamps, user identifiers, and other relevant metadata.

The audit logs are immutable snapshot records designed for compliance and security auditing. Access is strictly limited to administrators with appropriate authorization.

Security measures include rate limiting and stringent access controls to ensure audit data confidentiality and integrity. This operation integrates with the shopping_mall_admin_audit_logs snapshot table, returning paginated audit log summary records optimized for administrative review.

requestBody.description: Filtering and pagination parameters for searching admin audit logs

responseBody.description: Paginated list of admin audit log summary records matching search criteria

operations.name: index

operations.specification: This operation retrieves details of a single administrator audit log entry by its unique identifier from the shopping_mall_admin_audit_logs snapshot table. It provides full immutable audit information including who performed the action, when, and the specifics of the operation for security and compliance purposes.
operations.summary: Retrieve specific admin audit log entry by ID
operations.description:
Retrieve detailed information about a single administrator audit log entry identified by its unique UUID from the shopping mall platform. This includes comprehensive immutable audit data such as the action performed, the administrator who performed it, the timestamp, and any associated metadata.

Access is strictly limited to users with administrator privileges due to the sensitive nature of audit information.

This operation integrates directly with the shopping_mall_admin_audit_logs snapshot table and ensures a consistent, secure, and performant retrieval of audit records.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique UUID of the admin audit log entry

responseBody.description: Detailed admin audit log entry data

operations.name: at

operations.specification: This operation retrieves a filtered and paginated list of daily sales summaries from the materialized view mv_shopping_mall_daily_sales representing aggregated daily sales data for the entire shopping mall platform. It allows clients to query sales statistics by date ranges and other parameters, supporting performance monitoring and business analytics. The data is read-only and aggregated from transactional sources.
operations.description:
Retrieve a filtered and paginated list of daily sales summary records from the mv_shopping_mall_daily_sales materialized view.

This operation supports advanced filtering by sales date and other criteria, sorting, and pagination to efficiently explore daily sales trends.

Security considerations: This endpoint is public and does not require authentication as the data is aggregated and non-sensitive.

The materialized view aggregates transactional sales data into daily snapshots representing total number of orders, total sales amount, and total items sold on each day.

This resource is read-only; clients cannot modify the data.

Related operations: Retrieve individual day summary with GET /mvShoppingMallDailySales/{id}.
operations.summary: Retrieve paginated daily sales summaries of the shopping mall

requestBody.description: Search and pagination parameters for daily sales summaries filtering

responseBody.description: Paginated list of daily sales summary information matching search criteria

operations.name: index

operations.specification: This operation retrieves detailed information for a specific daily sales summary record identified by the unique id. The mv_shopping_mall_daily_sales materialized view provides aggregated daily sales data essential for performance monitoring and business analytics on the shopping mall platform. This resource is read-only and reflects pre-aggregated data from multiple transactional sources, ensuring high-performance queries for detailed daily sales.
operations.description:
Retrieve detailed information about a specific daily sales summary by unique identifier.

The sales summary contains total orders, total sales amount, and total items sold for the given sales date.

Security: This endpoint is public and read-only since the data is aggregated and non-sensitive.

This operation involves no data modification and serves analytics and monitoring use cases.

Related operation: List summary with PATCH /mvShoppingMallDailySales.
operations.summary: Retrieve a single daily sales summary record by unique ID

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the daily sales summary record

responseBody.description: Detailed daily sales summary information

operations.name: at

operations.specification: This operation retrieves a paginated list of inventory status records from the materialized view mv_shopping_mall_inventory_status. It allows clients to query current aggregated SKU inventory information across product categories in the shopping mall platform. The operation supports complex filtering, sorting, and paging to enable efficient monitoring of stock levels.
operations.summary: Retrieve paginated list of mall inventory status records
operations.description:
This operation retrieves paginated records from the materialized view mv_shopping_mall_inventory_status, which provides up-to-date aggregated SKU inventory information across the entire mall.

The materialized view consolidates inventory counts, low stock alerts, and SKU counts per product category to facilitate effective inventory monitoring and management. It serves as an optimized read-only queryable structure updated periodically to reflect transactional data.

Clients can specify filtering criteria and pagination options in the request body to tailor the results to their needs, such as viewing inventory status for specific categories or low stock SKUs.

Authorization for this endpoint is public as the inventory status information is general and not sensitive.

Related operations include GET /mvShoppingMallInventoryStatus/{id} for retrieving detailed information on a single inventory record.

requestBody.description: Search and pagination parameters for inventory status filtering

responseBody.description: Paginated list of inventory status records matching search criteria

operations.name: index

operations.specification: This operation retrieves a specific inventory status record identified by its unique ID from the materialized view mv_shopping_mall_inventory_status. It provides detailed aggregated SKU inventory information for a given product category.
operations.summary: Retrieve a single mall inventory status record by ID
operations.description:
This operation fetches detailed information for a single inventory status record by its UUID identifier from the materialized view mv_shopping_mall_inventory_status.

The information includes aggregated SKU counts, total inventory quantities, and low stock alert thresholds relevant to the specified product category.

As a read-only materialized view, this endpoint provides fast access to consolidated stock data without modifying any underlying transactional records.

Authorization is set to public as the data is non-sensitive and intended for general inventory monitoring.

Related operations: PATCH /mvShoppingMallInventoryStatus for searching multiple records with pagination.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: UUID identifier of the target inventory status record

responseBody.description: Detailed inventory status record

Equal to {@link records} / {@link limit} with ceiling.

access.description:
JWT access token for authenticated requests.

This token should be included in the Authorization header for subsequent
authenticated API requests as `Bearer {token}`.

refresh.description:
Refresh token for obtaining new access tokens.

This token can be used to request new access tokens when the current access
token expires, extending the user's session.

expired_at.description:
Access token expiration timestamp.

ISO 8601 date-time string indicating when the access token will expire and
can no longer be used for authentication.

refreshable_until.description:
Refresh token expiration timestamp.

ISO 8601 date-time string indicating the latest time until which the
refresh token can be used to obtain new access tokens.

IAuthorizationToken.description:
Authorization token response structure.

This interface defines the structure of the authorization token response
returned after successful user authentication. It contains both access and
refresh tokens along with their expiration information.

This token structure is automatically included in API schemas when the system
detects authorization actors in the requirements analysis phase. It provides
a standard format for JWT-based authentication across the generated backend
applications.

IShoppingMallGuest.IJoin.description: Payload to register a temporary guest account, enabling limited access with secure session management and token issuance. Contains essential identification and session context fields required for guest user onboarding.

name.description: Guest user's display name for identification, typically a nickname or pseudonym.

email.description: Guest user's email address for contact and account recovery. Optional but recommended to enable communication.

ip.description: Client IP address for session tracking and security monitoring. Optional, server can extract if not provided.

href.description: Connection URL indicating the current page URL to maintain context in the guest session. Mandatory for session creation.

referrer.description: Referrer URL indicating the previous page URL for auditing and analytics. Mandatory for session creation.

password.description: Guest account password to secure the temporary account. Must meet platform password policies.

IShoppingMallGuest.IAuthorized.description: Response schema containing guest user identification and JWT authorization tokens enabling access to protected resources.

id.description: Unique identifier of the authorized guest user.

created_at.description: Record creation timestamp indicating when the guest record was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last update to the guest record.

IShoppingMallGuest.IRefresh.description: Payload containing a valid refresh token for guest users to obtain new JWT authorization tokens. Validates refresh tokens against the 'shopping_mall_guest_sessions' table to ensure session validity. Required for maintaining secure, persistent guest access.

refresh_token.description: Valid refresh token assigned during registration or previous refresh operation

IShoppingMallCustomer.ICreate.description:
Customer creation information including email and plain text password for shopping mall registration.

Includes the minimal necessary data for registration such as unique email and plain password that backend hashes securely.

Session context fields href and referrer are required for auditing and security tracking of self-signup operations.

Does NOT include system-managed fields or IDs controlled by authentication context.

email.description: Unique customer email address used for login and communication. Must be valid and unique in the system.

password.description: Plain text customer password. The backend hashes this before storing securely. Never send hashed passwords here.

href.description: Connection URL (current page URL) provided by the client for session creation auditing. Mandatory for self-signup.

referrer.description: Referrer URL (previous page URL) provided by the client for session creation auditing. Mandatory for self-signup.

IShoppingMallCustomer.IAuthorized.description: Response object representing an authorized customer including user identifier and JWT token for authentication.

id.description: Unique identifier of the authenticated customer

email.description: Unique email address used for customer authentication and communication.

created_at.description: Timestamp representing when the customer record was created in the system.

updated_at.description: Timestamp representing when the customer record was last updated.

customer.description: Summary information of the authenticated customer

IShoppingMallCustomer.ILogin.description: Request body for customer login operation including credentials and session context.

email.description: Customer email address for authentication

password.description: Customer password in plain text for verification

ip.description: Client IP address for session tracking (OPTIONAL)

href.description: Connection URL (current page URL) provided by client, required

referrer.description: Referrer URL (previous page URL) provided by client, required

IShoppingMallCustomer.IRefresh.description:
Request data for refreshing an authenticated customer's access token using a valid refresh token.

This schema is used by the POST /auth/customer/refresh endpoint, ensuring secure token renewal without requiring re-authentication with credentials.

Includes the refresh token string and optional session context fields for proper auditing and security monitoring of refresh operations.

refresh_token.description: Refresh token string issued during initial authentication. This token allows the server to validate and issue a new access token without requiring re-login.

ip.description: Optional IP address from which the refresh request is made. This aids in security tracking and anomaly detection. Can be null if unknown or not provided.

href.description: Mandatory connection URL representing the current page or client location where the refresh request originates.

referrer.description: Mandatory referrer URL indicating the previous location navigated before this request, useful for security audits and session tracing.

IShoppingMallSeller.ICreate.description:
Schema for creating a new shopping mall seller registration.

The creation input requires a unique email and a password string which will be hashed and stored securely by the backend service.

Timestamps and ID are generated automatically and must not be included in the request.

email.description: Unique email address for the new seller registration.

password.description: Plain text password for authentication. This will be hashed and stored securely. Passwords must follow security guidelines.

IShoppingMallSeller.IAuthorized.description:
Authorization response object containing JWT tokens indicating successful authentication for a seller.

Returned upon login, join, or refresh token operations for seller users.

Contains the seller's unique identifier and the JWT access token payload.

Sensitive fields such as the password hash are removed to prevent exposure.

id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the authenticated seller.

email.description: Unique email address used for seller login authentication.

oneOf.description: Hashed password for seller authentication. This field is excluded from client responses for security reasons.

password_hash.description: Hashed password for seller authentication. This field is excluded from client responses for security reasons.

created_at.description: Record creation timestamp indicating when the seller was registered.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of last update to the seller record.

IShoppingMallSeller.ILogin.description:
Login request object for authenticating a seller user.

This type requires the seller's registered email and plain-text password for credential verification. It also includes session context fields to capture connection metadata such as client IP, referring URL, and current URL for security audit and session tracking.

All fields comply with the shopping_mall_sellers schema properties and authentication workflow requirements.

Used as a request body in the seller login endpoint.

email.description: Registered seller email address used for authentication.

password.description: Plain-text seller password for credential verification.

ip.description: Optional client IP address for session tracking. Can be extracted server-side or provided by client for SSR scenarios.

href.description: Connection current URL representing where the request originated from. Used for session context and auditing.

referrer.description: HTTP referrer URL indicating the previous page from which the connection was initiated.

IShoppingMallSeller.IRefresh.description:
Request body containing a valid refresh token for an authenticated seller.

Used to renew JWT access tokens and maintain security session continuity for seller users in the shopping mall system.

This schema ensures the client provides the necessary refresh token value for authentication token refresh operations.

refresh_token.description: JWT refresh token issued to the seller during login or join operations, used to obtain new access tokens. The token must be valid and unexpired.

IShoppingMallAdmin.IJoin.description:
Administrator registration data used to create a new admin account in the shopping mall system.

Includes the unique email for login and plain-text password to be hashed internally.

Session metadata fields are included for connection tracking.

This schema supports the initial admin account creation workflow.

email.description: Email address of the administrator; serves as the unique login identifier.

password.description: Plain-text password for account creation; it will be hashed internally before storage.

ip.description: Optional client IP address for session tracking; can be omitted or provided by the client for SSR scenarios.

href.description: Connection URL representing the current page URL from which the registration request is made; required for session context.

referrer.description: Referrer URL indicating the previous page URL; required for session context.

IShoppingMallAdmin.IAuthorized.description: Authorization response for an authenticated administrator including unique identifier and JWT token information.

id.description: Unique identifier of the authenticated administrator

email.description: Unique email address used for administrator login and communications.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this administrator record was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last update to this administrator's record.

IShoppingMallAdmin.ILogin.description: Request payload for administrator login including email and plain-text password, along with session metadata for auditing and security.

email.description: Administrator's email address used for authentication

ip.description: Client IP address for session tracking (optional, server can extract if not provided)

href.description: Connection URL (current page URL) mandatory for session context

referrer.description: Referrer URL (previous page URL) mandatory for session context

IShoppingMallAdmin.IRefresh.description: Refresh token submission for JWT renewal for an authenticated admin user on the shopping mall platform.

refreshToken.description: JWT refresh token string issued during authentication, used to obtain new access tokens.

IShoppingMallSystemConfiguration.IReques.description: Search and pagination parameters for querying shopping mall system configurations.

page.description: Page number to retrieve, starting from 1. Defaults to 1 if not specified.

limit.description: Number of items per page. Limits the size of the returned list to enhance performance.

search.description: Optional search string to filter system configurations based on keys or values.

sortBy.description: The field name to sort the results by. Typically one of the known system configuration fields.

oneOf.description: Sort order direction: ascending or descending
Sort order direction: ascending or descending

order.description: Sort order direction: ascending or descending

filter.description: Optional filtering criteria based on configuration keys or values. Key-value pairs where value can be a string, number, or boolean.

IShoppingMallSystemConfiguration.description:
Represents a system configuration parameter in the shopping mall platform.

This entity stores global configuration key-value pairs that control system-wide behavior and feature toggles.
Each configuration entry contains a unique key, its value as a string, a descriptive explanation of the parameter, and timestamps for creation, update, and soft deletion.

Access to these configurations is restricted to authorized administrators to ensure system integrity.

The entity supports soft deletion via the deleted_at field, enabling reversible disabling of configurations.

id.description: Unique identifier for the system configuration parameter.

key.description: Unique configuration key identifying the setting.

value.description: Configuration value stored as a string.

description.description: Detailed description explaining the purpose and usage of this configuration setting.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the configuration was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the configuration was last updated.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the configuration was soft deleted; null if active.

IShoppingMallSystemConfiguration.ICreate.description:
Request payload to create a new shopping mall system configuration parameter.

Includes the unique configuration key, the value as a string, and a detailed description.
Timestamps are managed automatically by the system and should not be included.

Access is restricted to administrative users to prevent unauthorized configuration changes.

key.description: Unique configuration key identifying the setting to be created.

value.description: Value of the configuration parameter as a string.

description.description: Detailed description of the configuration parameter for documentation and administrative review.

IShoppingMallSystemConfiguration.IUpdate.description:
Request DTO for updating an existing shopping mall system configuration entry.

This schema includes modifiable fields such as 'value' and 'description'. The 'key' field is immutable and excluded from update requests.

Timestamps 'created_at' and 'deleted_at' are system-managed and omitted from request bodies.

Only authorized administrators may perform updates as per authorization policies.

value.description: Configuration value stored as a string. Represents the updated value for the system configuration key.

description.description: Detailed description explaining the purpose and usage of this configuration setting. Can be updated to reflect changes in business rules or system behavior.

IShoppingMallCategory.IRequest.description:
Request DTO to retrieve a filtered and paginated list of shopping mall categories.

Supports parameters for filtering categories by name, status, and creation date range.
Allows clients to specify pagination controls such as page number and page size.
Facilitates advanced search operations with flexible query fields.

Security policies enforce rate limiting and data visibility restrictions based on user roles.

page.description: Page number for paginated results. Must be 1 or higher.

limit.description: Maximum number of categories returned per page. Must be between 1 and 100.

search.description: Search keyword to filter categories by name or description.

status.description: Filter categories by status. Typical values include 'active' or 'inactive'.

created_at_from.description: Start of date range for filtering categories by creation date. Inclusive. Can be null to omit lower bound.

created_at_to.description: End of date range for filtering categories by creation date. Inclusive. Can be null to omit upper bound.

IShoppingMallShoppingMallCategory.description:
Product categories used for organizing the catalog.

Represents business entities grouping products into meaningful hierarchies.
Categories have unique names, optional descriptions, status flags, and associated timestamps.
Soft deletion managed via deleted_at field to maintain historical record.

Crucial for organizing and filtering products in shopping mall platform.

Used throughout listing, creation, update, and retrieval operations.

Fields:
- id: Primary key identifier (uuid).
- name: Unique category code globally.
- description: Optional detailed information.
- status: Activation status flag.
- created_at: Creation timestamp.
- updated_at: Last modification timestamp.
- deleted_at: Soft deletion timestamp (nullable).

id.description: Unique identifier serving as the primary key for the shopping mall category.

name.description: Unique business code name of the category. Must be unique across all categories in the mall platform.

oneOf.description: Optional detailed descriptive text providing additional information about the category. Can be null if unspecified.

description.description: Optional detailed descriptive text providing additional information about the category. Can be null if unspecified.

status.description: Indicates whether the category is currently active or inactive in the catalog.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the category was created. ISO 8601 date-time format.

updated_at.description: Timestamp recording the last update time of the category in ISO 8601 format.

deleted_at.description: Nullable timestamp marking soft deletion time. Null indicates category is active and not soft deleted.

IShoppingMallShoppingMallCategory.ICreat.description:
Request payload to create a new shopping mall product category.

Includes all necessary fields required for adding a new category to the product catalog. The unique name must be specified.
No ID or timestamps are provided by the client as they are system generated.
Actor identity is managed by authentication context and not included here.

This DTO is used exclusively for the category creation API operation.

Fields:
- name: Unique name code for the category.
- description: Optional descriptive text for the new category.
- status: Initial active/inactive status on creation.

name.description: Unique name code for the category to be created. Must adhere to uniqueness constraints in the database.

oneOf.description: Optional descriptive text providing supplemental information about the new category.

description.description: Optional descriptive text providing supplemental information about the new category.

status.description: Initial status of the new category indicating whether it should be active or inactive upon creation.

IShoppingMallShoppingMallCategory.IUpdat.description:
Data structure for updating an existing shopping mall category.

This DTO contains all modifiable fields for the category entity in the shopping mall platform's product catalog.
It does not include identity or auto-generated properties. Administration authorization is required to perform updates.

Clients must supply the complete set of fields according to business rules, excluding those managed automatically or derived.

Fields such as timestamps and soft deletion are managed by the system and excluded here.

Actor identity is provided by context and not part of this DTO.

Fields:
- name: Unique name of the shopping mall category as primary business identifier.
- description: Optional detailed description for administrative purposes.
- status: Current active/inactive status of the category.

name.description: Unique name of the shopping mall category, serving as the primary business identifier within the product taxonomy.

oneOf.description: Optional detailed description of the category for administrative and display purposes.

description.description: Optional detailed description of the category for administrative and display purposes.

oneOf.description: Indicates that the category is currently active in the catalog.
Indicates that the category is currently inactive in the catalog.

status.description: Current status of the category indicating whether it is active or inactive within the catalog.

IShoppingMallCategoryHierarchy.IRequest.description:
Request body schema for searching and filtering category hierarchies under a specific parent category.

Supports pagination, sorting, and filtering criteria for efficient navigation of hierarchical trees.
The parent category context is supplied via path parameter (categoryName), so it is not repeated here.

This search DTO is designed for partial matches, ranges, and status filtering on child categories.

Pagination parameters follow standard conventions, ensuring consistent list responses.

Security controls are enforced at endpoint level; this DTO carries filtering parameters only.

page.description: Page number starting from 1 for paginated results.

limit.description: Number of items per page, with a sensible maximum to limit data volume.

oneOf.description: Text filter to search child category names or descriptions.

searchTerm.description: Text filter to search child category names or descriptions.

oneOf.description: Filter to include only categories matching specific status.
Filter to include only categories matching specific status.

statusFilter.description: Filter to include only categories matching specific status.

oneOf.description: Field by which to sort the results, such as name, created_at, or updated_at.
Field by which to sort the results, such as name, created_at, or updated_at.
Field by which to sort the results, such as name, created_at, or updated_at.

sortBy.description: Field by which to sort the results, such as name, created_at, or updated_at.

oneOf.description: Order direction for sorting results.
Order direction for sorting results.

IShoppingMallCategoryHierarchy.description: Represents a hierarchical link between two shopping mall categories indicating parent-child relationships for organizing the product catalog.

id.description: Unique identifier for the category hierarchy link

parent_category_name.description: Unique business identifier code of the parent shopping mall category

child_category_name.description: Unique business identifier code of the child shopping mall category

display_order.description: Determines the order in which the child category appears among siblings

is_active.description: Indicates if this hierarchy link is currently active

created_at.description: Timestamp when this hierarchy link was created

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this hierarchy link was last updated

notes.description: Optional notes or remarks about this hierarchy link

child_category_id.description: UUID of the child shopping mall category which becomes the descendant in the hierarchy.

IShoppingMallCategoryHierarchy.ICreate.description:
Request body schema to create a new category hierarchy link connecting a parent category to a child category.

The parent category context is provided via the categoryName path parameter in the API endpoint, so it is not included here.

Clients provide only the child category ID to establish the hierarchy link.

This prevents cycles and maintains the integrity of the hierarchy tree by enforcing proper parent-child relationships.

IShoppingMallCategory.ISummary.description:
Summary data for a product category in the shopping mall.

This schema provides a lightweight representation of the category entity, intended for use in lists, references, and embedding contexts. It includes core identifying information and status, without large descriptive fields.

Timestamps are also included to track creation and last update times, along with soft deletion status to indicate archival state.

It is derived from the shopping_mall_categories table and excludes excess verbose details for concise presentation.

id.description: Unique identifier of the category.

name.description: Name of the product category for display and filtering.

status.description: Current activation status of the category.

description.description: Optional detailed description of the category providing additional context and business insights.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the category was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the category was last updated.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp marking soft deletion; null means the category is active.

IShoppingMallCategoryHierarchy.IUpdate.description: Payload schema for updating a category hierarchy link in the shopping mall platform. Contains updatable fields specifying relationship details between parent and child categories.

parent_category_name.description: Unique business identifier code of the parent shopping mall category

child_category_name.description: Unique business identifier code of the child shopping mall category

display_order.description: Order number to define sorting priority of this hierarchy link among siblings

is_active.description: Indicates whether the hierarchy link is active or inactive

notes.description: Additional notes or remarks associated with this hierarchy link

IShoppingMallGuest.IRequest.description: Parameters for searching and filtering guests visiting the shopping mall.

page.description: Page number for paginated results (starting from 1)

limit.description: Number of results to return per page, capped for performance

created_after.description: Filter guests created after this date-time

created_before.description: Filter guests created before this date-time

updated_after.description: Filter guests updated after this date-time

updated_before.description: Filter guests updated before this date-time

id.description: Primary key UUID of the shopping mall guest user, uniquely identifying the guest session.

created_at.description: Timestamp indicating when the guest user record was created in the system.

updated_at.description: Timestamp indicating the most recent update to the guest user record.

IShoppingMallGuest.description: Represents an unauthenticated guest user browsing the e-commerce shopping mall. This entity stores session related information including creation and update timestamps to manage guest user state and analytics over time. Guest users do not have personal accounts or login credentials, so this entity facilitates tracking their activity anonymously for session management and analytical insights.

IShoppingMallGuest.IUpdate.description:
Request DTO for updating an existing guest user record.

Allows modification of guest session details and browsing related metadata.

Corresponds to the shopping_mall_guests table in the database.

Properties are optional to allow partial updates.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last update to the guest record.

IShoppingMallGuestSession.IRequest.description:
Request DTO for searching and paginating guest sessions in the shopping mall platform.

This schema is used to specify filtering criteria and pagination parameters when retrieving guest session records associated with a particular guest user. It supports filtering by session properties to enable precise querying and efficient data retrieval.

The structure aligns with the `shopping_mall_guest_sessions` table and includes pagination and search fields to control the number of results and navigation through pages.

page.description: Page number for pagination, starting from 1.

limit.description: Number of records to return per page, controlling page size.

search.description: Textual search string to filter guest sessions by IP or referrer URL.

shoppingMallGuestId.description: Unique identifier of the guest user whose sessions are being queried. This acts as a filter to return only sessions belonging to this guest.

id.description: Unique identifier for the guest session.

shopping_mall_guest_id.description: Reference ID linking this session to a guest user.

ip.description: IP address from which the session originated.

href.description: Connection URL associated with the session.

referrer.description: HTTP referrer header indicating the source of the session.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the guest session was created.

expired_at.description: Timestamp when the session expired; null if still active.

IShoppingMallGuestSession.description: Represents a shopping mall guest session which stores connection context details such as IP, connection URL, and referrer for auditing and session tracking purposes.

ip.description: IP address from which the session originates.

href.description: Connection URL to associate with the session.

referrer.description: Referrer URL linking to the session source.

expired_at.description: Expiration timestamp of the session; null if session is active.

IShoppingMallGuestSession.ICreate.description: Schema for creating a new shopping mall guest session, capturing connection metadata needed to track guest activity without requiring the session ID or the associated guest ID from the client, as these are derived from the path or server context.

ip.description: IP address from which the session originates.

href.description: Connection URL associated with the session.

referrer.description: Referrer URL linking to the session source.

expired_at.description: Expiration timestamp of the session; null if session is active.

IShoppingMallGuestSession.IUpdate.description: Schema for updating an existing guest session, consisting of modifiable session metadata such as connection information and expiration timestamp.

IShoppingMallCustomer.IRequest.description:
Request parameters for searching and paginating shopping mall customers.

This schema defines various criteria such as filtering by email, registration dates, and pagination controls to enable efficient querying of customer listings.

Used in the search operation for shopping mall customers in the admin context.

email.description: Filter customers by their email address. Supports partial or full matches.

createdAtStart.description: The earliest creation date for filtering customers registered on or after this datetime.

createdAtEnd.description: The latest creation date for filtering customers registered on or before this datetime.

page.description: Page number to retrieve in the paginated result set. Starts from 1.

pageSize.description: Number of items per page in the paginated result. Maximum allowed is 100.

email.description: The customer's unique email address for authentication and notifications.

IShoppingMallCustomer.IUpdate.description:
DTO for updating a shopping mall customer's mutable properties.

Includes only modifiable properties such as email. Password changes are handled via specialized mechanisms.

Authentication context handles identity, so no ID or created timestamps are accepted here.

IShoppingMallCustomer.description:
Represents a registered customer in the shopping mall system.

Contains essential information such as the unique identifier, email, and secure password hash used for authentication.

Includes system-managed timestamps for auditing registration and last update times.

Password hash is write-only and excluded from responses for security reasons.

This schema is used in various API responses and request bodies related to customer management.

id.description: Unique identifier for the customer.

email.description: Unique email address of the customer used for authentication.

created_at.description: Timestamp indicating when the customer record was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp indicating the last update time of the customer record.

IShoppingMallCustomerSession.IRequest.description: Parameters for paginating and filtering lists of shopping mall customer sessions in administrative contexts.

page.description: Page number for pagination of shopping mall customer sessions.

limit.description: Number of sessions to return per page.

sortBy.description: Field name to sort the session list.

oneOf.description: Sort order: ascending (asc) or descending (desc).
Sort order: ascending (asc) or descending (desc).

filter.description: Filter criteria object for searching sessions.

IShoppingMallCustomerSession.description:
Shopping mall customer session entity representing an authenticated session of a customer user.

This entity tracks connection details such as client IP address, accessed URL (href), HTTP referrer, session expiration, and timestamps for creation. The session is linked to a specific shopping mall customer to maintain security and session persistence across requests.

Sessions enable multi-device login and session management for customers.

id.description: Unique identifier of the shopping mall customer session

shopping_mall_customer_id.description: Unique identifier of the customer owning this session

ip.description: IP address from which the session is initiated

href.description: URL accessed during the session

referrer.description: HTTP referrer header information

created_at.description: Timestamp when the session is created

expired_at.description: Timestamp when the session expires; null if session is still active

duration_minutes.description: Duration of the session in minutes

is_active.description: Indicates whether the session is currently active

device_info.description: Information identifying the client device for the session

user_agent.description: User agent string from the client's browser or app

IShoppingMallCustomerSession.ICreate.description:
Request payload to create a new shopping mall customer session.

Includes connection information required to establish session tracking.

The session is linked to the customer by the path parameter `shoppingMallCustomerId`. Actor ID injection is handled server-side, so the request must NOT contain `shopping_mall_customer_id`.

Contains session context fields required for establishing the session, such as IP address, connection URL (href), and HTTP referrer.

ip.description: IP address of the new session.

href.description: Connection URL for the session.

referrer.description: HTTP Referrer header value for session creation.

expired_at.description: Optional timestamp when the session should expire. Null means no expiration.

duration_minutes.description: Duration of the session in minutes

is_active.description: Indicates whether the session is currently active

device_info.description: Information identifying the client device for the session

user_agent.description: User agent string from the client's browser or app

IShoppingMallCustomerSession.IUpdate.description:
Update DTO for shopping mall customer session allowing modifications to session-specific properties.

Excluded immutable fields: id, shopping_mall_customer_id, created_at.

Fields allowed to be updated include connection IP, accessed URL, HTTP referrer, expiration timestamp, session duration, active status, device information, and user agent details.

Actor identity is injected server-side and must NOT be present in the request.

ip.description: Updated IP address of the session

href.description: Updated URL accessed during the session

referrer.description: Updated HTTP referrer header information

expired_at.description: Updated expiration timestamp of the session; null means session does not expire yet

duration_minutes.description: Updated duration of the session in minutes

is_active.description: Updated active status indicator of the session

device_info.description: Updated device info of the client

IShoppingMallSeller.IRequest.description:
Request DTO for querying a paginated list of shopping mall sellers with filters and sort options.

This DTO supports pagination, filtering, and sorting parameters for administrative seller management operations.

Fields include pagination details, search terms, email filtering, creation date range, and sorting preferences.

page.description: Page number to retrieve in paginated results

limit.description: Number of records to retrieve per page

search_term.description: General search term to match seller emails or names

email_filter.description: Filter sellers by their email address

created_since.description: Filter sellers created after this timestamp; null means no lower bound

created_until.description: Filter sellers created before this timestamp; null means no upper bound

oneOf.description: Field name to sort by
Field name to sort by
Field name to sort by
Sort order direction
Sort order direction

include_inactive.description: Flag indicating whether to include inactive sellers in results

has_verified_email.description: Filter to only include sellers with verified email addresses

min_sales_count.description: Filter sellers with at least this number of sales

max_sales_count.description: Filter sellers with at most this number of sales

id.description: Unique seller identifier.

IShoppingMallSeller.ISummary.description: Summary information about a seller within the shopping mall platform.

IShoppingMallSeller.description:
Represents a registered shopping mall seller user responsible for managing product listings and fulfilling orders in the shopping mall platform.

This entity contains authentication credentials including an email and a hashed password, along with timestamps for record creation and last update.

Sensitive fields such as password hashes are excluded from response schemas for security purposes.

Used in administrative operations to manage seller accounts and by sellers for profile management.

id.description: Unique identifier for the shopping mall seller.

email.description: Unique email address used for seller login authentication.

oneOf.description: Hashed password for seller authentication. This field is excluded from client responses for security reasons.

password_hash.description: Hashed password for seller authentication. This field is excluded from client responses for security reasons.

created_at.description: Record creation timestamp indicating when the seller was registered.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of last update to the seller record.

IShoppingMallSeller.IUpdate.description:
Schema for updating an existing shopping mall seller's details.

All fields are optional except the ID which is set via the path parameter.

The password cannot be updated via this endpoint and is excluded from this schema for security.

The email can be updated to change the seller's login credentials.

Timestamps are not included in the update request and managed by the system.

email.description: Updated email address for the seller.

IShoppingMallSellerSession.IRequest.description:
Filters and pagination parameters for querying shopping mall seller sessions.

Enables retrieval of session records matching specific criteria for a seller user, supporting efficient data access with pagination and optional filters.

Used in PATCH /shoppingMall/seller/shoppingMallSellers/{shoppingMallSellerId}/shoppingMallSellerSessions endpoint to refine session listings.

page.description: Page number of the results to retrieve. Starts at 1.

limit.description: Number of items per page for pagination. Used to control page size.

sortField.description: Field name to sort results by. Accepts session record property names such as created_at or expired_at.

oneOf.description: Sort order direction for the results.
Sort order direction for the results.

sortOrder.description: Sort order direction for the results.

filterActive.description: Flag to filter only active sessions (not expired). True to return only active sessions, false to include expired ones.

IShoppingMallSellerSession.description:
Session record entity representing an authenticated connection of a shopping mall seller.

Includes network metadata for the session such as IP address, connection URL, and HTTP referrer.
Tracks lifecycle events with creation and optional expiration timestamps.

Used in session management features to audit and maintain seller sessions securely.

Direct mapping to the shopping_mall_seller_sessions Prisma database table.
Supports listing, detail retrieval, creation, and update operations.

id.description: Primary unique identifier for the session record generated by the database. This field is immutable.

shoppingMallSellerId.description: Unique identifier of the shopping mall seller associated with this session. Derived from authenticated context; not included in creation or update requests.

ip.description: IP address from which the session was initiated. Recorded for auditing and security analysis. Optional in creation and update, as it may be extracted by backend.

href.description: Connection URL used by the session. Captures the exact URL from which the session originated for traceability. Required for creation with URI format.

referrer.description: HTTP referrer header value sent with the session request. Provides context about the navigation source. Required for creation with URI format.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the session was created. Used for session lifecycle tracking. This field is immutable.

expiredAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the session expires. Null if the session is still active. Optional.

IShoppingMallSellerSession.ICreate.description:
DTO for creating a shopping mall seller session.

Contains the necessary information to create a new session for a shopping mall seller user, including session metadata properties. Excludes authentication actor fields, which are injected by the server.

ip.description: IP address of the seller for session tracking, optional client-provided or server-extracted.

href.description: Connection URL of the session client. Must be provided by the client for audit purposes.

referrer.description: Referrer URL indicating the previous URL the client came from. Required for tracking and validation.

user_agent.description: User agent string of the client's browser or app. Optional but recommended for identification.

fingerprint.description: Unique fingerprint hash representing the client device or session. Optional but recommended for session analysis.

IShoppingMallSellerSession.IUpdate.description:
DTO for updating an existing shopping mall seller session.

Allows partial updates to session information such as IP address, user agent, and fingerprint. Does not include immutable or server-managed fields.

ip.description: Optional updated IP address for the session.

user_agent.description: Updated user agent string of the client.

fingerprint.description: Updated unique fingerprint hash of the client session.

page.description: Page number for pagination, starting from 1.

limit.description: Number of records per page.

search.description: Text search keyword to filter admin users by email or other fields.

sortField.description: Field by which to sort the results.

oneOf.description: Sort order, either 'asc' or 'desc'.
Sort order, either 'asc' or 'desc'.

IShoppingMallAdmin.IRequest.description: Search criteria and pagination parameters for filtering admins.

IShoppingMallAdmin.ISummary.description:
Summary information of platform administrators who have full permissions to manage users, products, orders, and platform settings.

Provides basic identifying information required for audit and administrative interfaces, excluding sensitive credentials like password hashes.

Used primarily for list views and references to administrators.

id.description: Unique identifier of the administrator.

email.description: Unique email address used for administrator login authentication.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the administrator record was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the administrator record was last updated.

IShoppingMallAdmin.description:
Represents platform administrators responsible for managing users, products, orders, and platform settings within the shopping mall.

Administrators have unique login credentials and session management to ensure security and auditability.

This entity is critical for maintaining system health, monitoring orders, and enforcing user moderation policies.

Includes core identity and security credentials like email and password hash.

Used in administrator management APIs with full administrative privileges.

id.description: Unique identifier for the shopping mall administrator.

email.description: Unique email address used for administrator login and communications.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the administrator account was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last update to the administrator account.

IShoppingMallAdmin.IUpdate.description:
Request body schema for updating a shopping mall administrator's information.

Allows modifying the administrator's email and password fields.
Timestamps and identifier fields are read-only and managed by the system.

Security-sensitive fields, such as the password, are only accessible for update, never for retrieval.

Requests must follow validation rules for email uniqueness and password formats.

email.description: New unique email address for the administrator. Must be unique in the system.

password.description: Plain-text password to secure the administrator account.

IShoppingMallAdminSession.IRequest.description:
Parameters for querying filtered and paginated session records of a shopping mall administrator.

Supports searching, sorting, and pagination for effective session management and auditing by administrators.

Includes filters like expiration status and IP address matching, allowing administrators to monitor individual sessions.

Used in PATCH operation to retrieve paginated lists of administrator sessions conforming to search criteria.

page.description: Page number for pagination, starting from 1.

limit.description: Maximum number of session records to return per page.

search.description: Search string to filter sessions by IP, URL, or referrer.

sort_by.description: Metadata field name to sort the session results by.

oneOf.description: Sort order: ascending or descending.
Sort order: ascending or descending.

expired_only.description: If true, only returns sessions that have expired.

IShoppingMallAdminSession.ISummary.description:
Summary information of session records for platform administrators managing platform access.

Sessions track connection context such as IP address, connection URLs, and referrers for auditing and security.

Used primarily for displaying active or recent administrator sessions in monitoring interfaces.

id.description: Unique identifier of the administrator session.

shopping_mall_admin_id.description: Foreign key referencing the administrator owning this session.

ip.description: IP address from which the session was initiated.

href.description: Connection URL representing the session's source URL.

referrer.description: HTTP referrer header indicating the source URL of the session.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

expired_at.description: Nullable timestamp when the session expires; null if still active.

IShoppingMallAdminSession.description:
Represents a session record for a shopping mall administrator, tracking connection context for auditing, security, and management purposes.

Each session is linked to exactly one admin user identified by shoppingMallAdminId and records detailed session metadata including IP address, connection URL, referrer, and timestamps for creation and expiration.

This schema maps directly to the shopping_mall_admin_sessions Prisma database model, ensuring data consistency between the API and database.

Sensitive information like authentication tokens is excluded for security.

id.description: Unique identifier for the admin session record.

shoppingMallAdminId.description: Unique identifier of the associated shopping mall administrator user.

ip.description: IP address from which the admin session was initiated.

href.description: URL accessed during the admin session.

referrer.description: HTTP referrer header indicating the source of the session initiation.

created_at.description: Timestamp marking when the admin session was created.

expired_at.description: Timestamp marking when the admin session expires. Null if the session is still active.

IShoppingMallAdminSession.ICreate.description:
Schema for creating a new admin session record linked to a specified administrator.

Includes connection context details such as IP address, accessed URL, and referrer information.

The creation timestamp is automatically recorded by the system and must not be provided by clients.

The shoppingMallAdminId is obtained from the authenticated admin user context and therefore excluded from the request body.

This design ensures secure, auditable session creation for platform administrators.

ip.description: IP address from which the admin session is initiated.

href.description: URL accessed during the admin session.

referrer.description: HTTP referrer header indicating the source of the session initiation.

IShoppingMallAdminSession.IUpdate.description:
Schema for updating an existing admin session record.

Allows modification of connection context details such as IP address, URL, referrer, and the session expiration timestamp.

This schema ensures secure management of session lifecycle by authenticated admins.

Properties are optional to allow partial updates.

ip.description: Updated IP address of the admin session.

href.description: Updated URL accessed during the admin session.

referrer.description: Updated HTTP referrer header of the admin session.

expired_at.description: New expiration timestamp for the admin session. Null to clear expiration.

IShoppingMallShoppingMallCategory.ISumma.description:
Summary information of a product category within the shopping mall.

This summary type provides essential identification and naming information.

Detailed fields, timestamps, or soft deletion status are excluded for performance and data minimization in list contexts.

id.description: Unique identifier of the category.

name.description: Category name for business display and filtering.

IShoppingMallProductVariant.IRequest.description: Request schema for filtering, sorting, and paginating shopping mall product variants. Supports criteria such as color, size, price ranges, status, and pagination parameters. Used to retrieve lists of product variants matching specific search conditions.

color.description: Filter by color attribute of the product variant. Optional; can be set to null to disregard this filter.

size.description: Filter by size attribute of the product variant. Optional; can be set to null to disregard this filter.

option.description: Filter by additional customizable options for the product variant. Optional; can be set to null.

min_price.description: Minimum price threshold to filter product variants. Must be a non-negative number.

max_price.description: Maximum price threshold to filter product variants. Must be a non-negative number and not less than min_price.

status.description: Filter by availability status such as 'in stock' or 'discontinued'. Optional; can be null to include all statuses.

page.description: Page number for paginated results. Default is 1.

limit.description: Maximum number of items per result page. Default and maximum allowed is 100.

sort_by.description: Sort key to order the results. Optional; can be null for default ordering.

order.description: Ordering direction: 'asc' or 'desc'. Optional; can be null for default order.

IShoppingMallProductVariant.description:
Represents a distinct product variant (SKU) within the shopping mall platform. Each variant corresponds to a unique combination of attributes such as SKU code, color, size, and other optional features. This model enables precise inventory and pricing management for individual SKU-level items tied to a parent product.

The variant maintains a reference to its parent product via the product ID, enabling relational linkage and aggregation. Price and status fields reflect current configuration and availability. Timestamp fields track creation, updates, and soft deletion status, conforming to database-level operations.

Used in detailed product variant retrieval, creation, and update operations where SKU-specific information is required.

shopping_mall_product_id.description: UUID of the parent shopping mall product to which this variant belongs. This links the variant to its associated product.

sku_code.description: Unique SKU code assigned to this product variant, ensuring distinct identification within the catalog.

oneOf.description: Optional color attribute specifying the variant's color.

color.description: Optional color attribute specifying the variant's color.

oneOf.description: Optional size attribute specifying variant dimensions or scale.

size.description: Optional size attribute specifying variant dimensions or scale.

oneOf.description: Additional optional features or customizations relevant to this variant.

option.description: Additional optional features or customizations relevant to this variant.

price.description: The retail price of this SKU variant, reflecting current selling rates.

status.description: Current availability status of the variant, e.g., "in stock", "discontinued", or other lifecycle indicators.

created_at.description: Timestamp recording when the variant record was initially created in the system.

updated_at.description: Timestamp recording the last update time of the variant record, indicating recent modifications or status changes.

deleted_at.description: Nullable timestamp indicating when the variant was soft deleted. Null if the variant is active and not deleted.

IShoppingMallProductVariant.ICreate.description:
Request body schema for creating a new product variant (SKU) under an existing shopping mall product. The variant encapsulates identifying and descriptive attributes necessary for SKU differentiation, pricing, and status at the variant level.

The shopping_mall_product_id must be provided to link this variant to its parent product. SKU code uniqueness is enforced. Optional attributes like color, size, and option allow for rich variant definitions. Price and status fields are mandatory to establish initial availability and cost.

Timestamps are managed by the system and must not be submitted by the client. The deleted_at field is omitted in creation.

Actor identity is managed via authentication context and not included here.

shopping_mall_product_id.description: UUID of the parent shopping mall product. The new variant will be associated with this product.

sku_code.description: Unique SKU code for the new product variant.

oneOf.description: Optional color attribute for the variant.

color.description: Optional color attribute for the variant.

oneOf.description: Optional size attribute for the variant.

size.description: Optional size attribute for the variant.

oneOf.description: Additional custom options or features for the variant.

option.description: Additional custom options or features for the variant.

price.description: Price at which this product variant will be sold.

status.description: Initial availability or lifecycle status for this variant.

IShoppingMallProductVariant.IUpdate.description: Request body schema used for updating an existing shopping mall product variant. It allows authorized sellers to modify variant attributes including color, size, option selections, price, and status. Actor identity fields are excluded as they are injected by authentication context.

oneOf.description: Color attribute of the product variant. Null if unspecified.

color.description: Color attribute of the product variant. Null if unspecified.

oneOf.description: Size attribute of the product variant. Null if unspecified.

size.description: Size attribute of the product variant. Null if unspecified.

oneOf.description: Additional customizable options for the variant. Null if unspecified.

option.description: Additional customizable options for the variant. Null if unspecified.

price.description: Price for this product variant. Must be a non-negative value reflecting the current sale price.

status.description: Current availability status of the product variant, indicating if it is in stock, discontinued, or otherwise.

IShoppingMallInventory.IRequest.description:
Request schema for searching and filtering the inventories of a specific product variant SKU.

Supports advanced filtering including quantity ranges, reserved quantities, restock date filters, and pagination parameters to manage large datasets effectively.

Access to this operation is generally restricted to authorized sellers and administrators to ensure inventory security.

page.description: Page number for paginated results. Must be a positive integer and defaults to 1 if unspecified.

limit.description: Maximum number of inventory records to return per page. Must be a positive integer typically capped to prevent excessive data transfer.

oneOf.description: Minimum stock quantity filter. Null means no minimum filter applied.

quantity_min.description: Minimum stock quantity filter. Null means no minimum filter applied.

oneOf.description: Maximum stock quantity filter. Null means no maximum filter applied.

quantity_max.description: Maximum stock quantity filter. Null means no maximum filter applied.

oneOf.description: Minimum reserved quantity filter. Null means no minimum filter applied.

reserved_quantity_min.description: Minimum reserved quantity filter. Null means no minimum filter applied.

oneOf.description: Maximum reserved quantity filter. Null means no maximum filter applied.

reserved_quantity_max.description: Maximum reserved quantity filter. Null means no maximum filter applied.

oneOf.description: Filter inventories with restock dates on or after this timestamp in ISO 8601 format. Null disables this filter.

restock_date_from.description: Filter inventories with restock dates on or after this timestamp in ISO 8601 format. Null disables this filter.

oneOf.description: Filter inventories with restock dates on or before this timestamp in ISO 8601 format. Null disables this filter.

restock_date_to.description: Filter inventories with restock dates on or before this timestamp in ISO 8601 format. Null disables this filter.

IShoppingMallInventory.description:
Inventory records tracking SKU stock levels and availability.

Each inventory entry is associated with a specific product variant (SKU) and monitors stock quantities, reserved quantities, and restock dates. Supports soft deletion and temporal tracking for audit purposes.

The inventory system is critical for enforcing stock constraints and preventing overselling.

Represents the stock management details for a specific product variant within the shopping mall platform. It includes the total available quantity, reserved stock for pending orders, and optional restock date information to assist with inventory planning and fulfillment.

This entity is linked to the product variant entity and is used in both inventory management and order processing contexts.

Used in GET, POST, and PUT API operations to retrieve, create, and update inventory data respectively.

id.description: Primary key. Unique identifier for the inventory record.

shopping_mall_product_variant_id.description: Foreign key referencing the associated product variant SKU record.

quantity.description: Total stock available for the inventory entry. This value is decremented as items are sold or reserved.

reserved_quantity.description: Quantity of stock currently reserved for pending orders and unavailable for sale.

restock_date.description: Optional date-time indicating when the next stock is expected to arrive. Null if unknown or not scheduled.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this inventory record was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this inventory record was last updated.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp marking when this inventory record was soft-deleted. Null if the record is active.

IShoppingMallInventory.ICreate.description:
Payload schema for creating a new inventory record linked to a specific product variant in the shopping mall platform.

Includes stock quantities, reserved quantities, and optional restock date. The foreign key to the product variant is provided via the URL path parameter and thus excluded from this payload.

Timestamps are handled automatically by the system and should not be supplied by the client.

Security: Inventory management operations require authorization and authentication by appropriate users.

quantity.description: Initial stock quantity available for the product variant. Must be zero or positive.

reserved_quantity.description: Initial quantity reserved for pending orders. Usually zero on creation.

restock_date.description: Optional anticipated date and time for restocking this product variant's inventory. Null if unknown.

IShoppingMallInventory.IUpdate.description: DTO for updating an existing shopping mall inventory record. This schema allows modification of stock quantities, reserved quantities, restock dates, and temporal tracking fields such as createdAt, updatedAt, and deletedAt. Client must not include immutable identifiers; updates must maintain data integrity and consistency.

quantity.description: Total stock available for this inventory entry.

reserved_quantity.description: Quantity reserved for pending orders, reducing available stock.

restock_date.description: Expected date of next restock for replenishing stock; nullable if unknown.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this inventory record was initially created; system managed.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this inventory record was last updated; system managed.

deleted_at.description:
Nullable timestamp indicating soft deletion; 
when set, this record is considered deleted but kept for audit trails.

IShoppingMallProductSnapshot.IRequest.description: Search and pagination parameters for querying shopping mall product snapshots representing historical product data. Supports filtering by product IDs, snapshot date ranges, and other criteria to enable audit and versioning use cases.

page.description: Page number for pagination; default is 1.

limit.description: Number of items per page; default depends on server settings.

sort_by.description: Field name to sort the results by such as snapshot_at or created_at.

filter_snapshot_at_gte.description: Filter product snapshots created on or after this timestamp.

filter_snapshot_at_lte.description: Filter product snapshots created on or before this timestamp.

IShoppingMallProductSnapshot.description:
Detailed historical snapshot of a shopping mall product captured at a specific point in time.

This snapshot stores a denormalized representation of the product, including code, title, description, brand, and timestamps.
