Snapshots are immutable and append-only, used mainly for auditing, compliance, and troubleshooting by administrators.

Includes reference to the original product via shopping_mall_product_id foreign key.

id.description: Unique identifier of the product snapshot record.

shopping_mall_product_id.description: Identifier of the original product to which this snapshot belongs.

code.description: Product code at the time the snapshot was created.

title.description: Product title at the time the snapshot was created.

description.description: Optional product description at the time of snapshot creation.

brand.description: Optional product brand at the time the snapshot was created.

snapshot_at.description: Timestamp indicating when this snapshot was captured.

created_at.description: Timestamp of record creation in the database.

IShoppingMallCart.IRequest.description:
Search criteria and pagination parameters for querying shopping mall carts.

Supports filtering by customer ID, session ID, and timestamps. Pagination parameters control page size and offset.

Used by customers to view or manage their shopping carts.

SECURITY FIX: Removed authentication context fields to prevent client-supplied actor identity and session info.

created_at_from.description: Filter carts created at or after this timestamp.

created_at_to.description: Filter carts created before this timestamp.

updated_at_from.description: Filter carts last updated at or after this timestamp.

updated_at_to.description: Filter carts last updated before this timestamp.

deleted_at.description: Filter by deletion timestamp to include or exclude soft-deleted carts.

page.description: Page number for pagination starting from 1.

limit.description: Number of records to return per page, capped at 100.

IShoppingMallCart.description:
Shopping mall carts represent persistent collections of selected product SKUs intended for purchase by customers. Each cart belongs to a specific registered customer and optionally a customer session to track individual browsing sessions. The cart data supports lifecycle fields for creation, updates, and soft deletion enabling audit and data integrity. This entity is critical for managing customer shopping selections that persist across sessions, facilitating purchase processes.

Properties:
- id: Unique UUID identifier for the shopping cart.
- shopping_mall_customer_id: UUID reference to the owning customer - excluded in request create/update DTOs as it comes from authenticated user context.
- shopping_mall_customer_session_id: UUID reference to the specific customer session, nullable, assists in session tracking across browsing sessions.
- created_at: Timestamp when the cart was created.
- updated_at: Timestamp when the cart was last updated.
- deleted_at: Nullable timestamp indicating soft deletion status; null if the cart is active.

Relationships:
- Shopping mall carts reference customers and sessions as ownership and context.

This structure supports persistence and lifecycle management of customer shopping carts in the shopping mall.

id.description: Unique identifier of the shopping mall cart.

shopping_mall_customer_session_id.description: Reference to the specific customer session associated with this cart. Nullable to allow absence of session context.

created_at.description: Timestamp recording when the shopping cart was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp recording when the shopping cart was last updated.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp indicating if the cart has been soft deleted. Null if the cart is active.

shopping_mall_customer_id.description: Reference to the owning customer user. This field is excluded in request DTOs as it is provided implicitly by the authenticated user's context.

IShoppingMallCartItem.IRequest.description: Filtering, pagination, and sorting parameters for querying shopping mall cart items in a specific cart. Removed shopping_mall_cart_id path parameter to prevent duplication and security issues.

page.description: Page number for pagination, starting from 1.

limit.description: Number of records to return per page.

search.description: Search query string to filter cart items by matching criteria.

quantity.description: Filter cart items by their quantity value.

created_at_after.description: Filter items created after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

created_at_before.description: Filter items created before this ISO 8601 timestamp.

updated_at_after.description: Filter items updated after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

updated_at_before.description: Filter items updated before this ISO 8601 timestamp.

deleted_at_null.description: When true, fetch only active (not soft deleted) items.

deleted_at_after.description: Filter items soft deleted after this timestamp.

deleted_at_before.description: Filter items soft deleted before this timestamp.

shopping_mall_product_variant_id.description: Filter items by the associated product variant SKU UUID.

sort_by.description: Field name to sort results by (e.g., quantity, created_at).

oneOf.description: Sort order direction, either ascending ('asc') or descending ('desc').
Sort order direction, either ascending ('asc') or descending ('desc').

sort_order.description: Sort order direction, either ascending ('asc') or descending ('desc').

IShoppingMallCartItem.description:
Represents an individual item within a shopping mall cart, specifying a particular product variant (SKU) and its quantity selected by the customer.

Each cart item belongs to one shopping mall cart and references a single product variant, encapsulating the intersection of cart and product at SKU level with quantity and lifecycle timestamps.

This entity is used in responses for cart item retrieval, updates, and list views.

id.description: Unique identifier of the shopping mall cart item.

shopping_mall_cart_id.description: UUID of the shopping mall cart this item belongs to.

shopping_mall_product_variant_id.description: UUID of the product variant (SKU) this item refers to.

quantity.description: The quantity of the product variant selected in the cart item.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the cart item was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the cart item was last updated.

deleted_at.description: Soft deletion timestamp; if null, the item is active.

IShoppingMallCartItem.ICreate.description: Request body schema for creating a new shopping mall cart item. Excludes user identification fields which are obtained from the authenticated JWT context. Includes quantity and reference to the selected product variant.

quantity.description: Number of units of the product variant to add to the cart. Must be at least 1.

shoppingMallProductVariantId.description: Unique identifier of the product variant to add to the shopping cart.

IShoppingMallCartItem.IUpdate.description: Request body schema for updating an existing shopping mall cart item. Allows modification of quantity and product variant reference. User identification fields excluded as they are supplied from authenticated context.

quantity.description: Updated quantity of the product variant in the cart item. Must be at least 1.

shoppingMallProductVariantId.description: Unique identifier of the product variant associated with this cart item, enabling replacement or changes if necessary.

IShoppingMallWishlist.description:
Represents a shopping mall wishlist owned by a single customer, storing references to desired product SKUs saved for future purchases.

The entity includes creation and update timestamps, along with support for soft deletion via a nullable deleted_at field.

Security constraints ensure that customers can only access their own wishlists. This schema is used in responses for detailed wishlist retrieval operations.

id.description: Unique identifier for the wishlist entry. This is the primary key.

shopping_mall_customer_id.description: UUID of the customer owning this wishlist.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the wishlist was created. This value is immutable once set.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the wishlist was last updated. Updates whenever the wishlist content changes.

deleted_at.description: Soft delete timestamp. Contains the date-time when the wishlist was soft-deleted, or null if the wishlist is active.

IShoppingMallWishlist.ICreate.description: Request body schema for creating a new wishlist belonging to a customer in the shopping mall system. Excludes authentication context and system-managed fields to ensure security compliance.

name.description: Name of the wishlist to display for the customer. Must be a meaningful, user-friendly label to identify the list.

IShoppingMallWishlist.IUpdate.description:
Data structure for updating a customer's shopping mall wishlist.

Allows modification of wishlist details while maintaining association with the owning customer. System-managed timestamps except soft deletion handled server-side are excluded from client updates.

deleted_at.description: Soft deletion timestamp indicating when the wishlist was deleted. Null if the wishlist is active.

IShoppingMallWishlistItem.IRequest.description:
Parameters for filtering, sorting, and paginating shopping mall wishlist items within a specific wishlist.

Includes options to search, specify pagination, and order the returned wishlist items appropriately.

page.description: Page number for pagination of wishlist items. Starts at 1.

limit.description: Number of items per page in the paginated response.

search.description: Search term to filter wishlist items by relevant text fields.

sort_by.description: Field name to sort the wishlist items by.

oneOf.description: Sort order for returned wishlist items, ascending or descending.
Sort order for returned wishlist items, ascending or descending.

order.description: Sort order for returned wishlist items, ascending or descending.

IShoppingMallWishlistItem.description:
An individual item within a customer's wishlist in the shopping mall system.

This entity represents a specific product variant (SKU) saved by the customer for potential future purchase. It includes relational links to the owning wishlist and the selected product variant, as well as timestamp fields tracking creation, updates, and soft deletion status.

This item is a subsidiary entity to ShoppingMallWishlist and ShoppingMallProductVariant, facilitating normalized and efficient data management of customer wishlists.

id.description: Unique identifier of the wishlist item.

shopping_mall_wishlist_id.description: Identifier linking this item to its parent wishlist.

shopping_mall_product_variant_id.description: Identifier of the selected product variant (SKU) saved in the wishlist.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the wishlist item was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the wishlist item was last updated.

deleted_at.description: Soft deletion timestamp; null if item is active and not deleted.

IShoppingMallWishlistItem.ICreate.description:
Payload for creating a new wishlist item in a shopping mall wishlist.

Represents an individual product SKU that a customer saves to their wishlist, allowing customers to manage their desired items for potential future purchases.

Includes a reference to the product variant being added and any other necessary properties excluding system and ownership fields.

This DTO is used for POST requests to add items to a wishlist.

shoppingMallProductVariantId.description: Unique identifier of the product variant SKU being added to the wishlist

oneOf.description: Optional note or comment for the wishlist item, provided by the customer

note.description: Optional note or comment for the wishlist item, provided by the customer

IShoppingMallWishlistItem.IUpdate.description:
DTO for updating properties of a shopping mall wishlist item.

Allows modification of the wishlist item attributes like changing the selected product variant within an existing wishlist item record. Authenticated customer ownership is enforced at the API level.

Fields that identify the wishlist or the item are path parameters and thus excluded from request body.

Sensitive and system-managed fields like creation timestamps are excluded from updates.

This DTO supports partial updates; all fields are optional.

shopping_mall_product_variant_id.description: Reference to the selected product variant (SKU). This field identifies the specific SKU saved in the wishlist item. It must be a valid UUID of the product variant.

IShoppingMallOrder.IRequest.description:
Parameters for searching and paginating shopping mall orders.

Supports filtering by order number, status, payment status, customer, seller, and date ranges. Pagination and sorting options are included to enable efficient queries.

Security considerations restrict access to authorized actors only, filtering orders based on user roles.

This request DTO corresponds to search parameters applicable to orders stored in the shopping_mall_orders table.

page.description: Pagination page number to retrieve. Must be a positive integer indicating which page of results to fetch.

limit.description: Maximum number of order records to retrieve per page. Controls the page size for paginated responses.

search.description: Search string to filter orders by fields such as order number or customer information. Performs partial matches to support user query.

sortBy.description: Field name to sort the order results by. Common sortable fields include creation date, order number, and total amount.

oneOf.description: Order direction for sorting: 'asc' for ascending, 'desc' for descending.
Order direction for sorting: 'asc' for ascending, 'desc' for descending.

sortOrder.description: Order direction for sorting: 'asc' for ascending, 'desc' for descending.

IShoppingMallOrder.description:
Represents a shopping mall order entity corresponding to the shopping_mall_orders table in the database.

Each order captures purchase transaction details including associated customer and seller, unique order number, status fields, total amount, shipping address at time of order placement, and lifecycle timestamps.

This entity supports soft delete functionality indicated by the optional deleted_at timestamp. Ownership and authorization involve the customer role creating and managing orders.

Used as the main response DTO for order-related operations.

id.description: Unique identifier for the order.

shopping_mall_customer_id.description: UUID of the customer who placed the order.

shopping_mall_seller_id.description: UUID of the seller responsible for fulfilling the order.

order_number.description: Unique business reference number for the order used in tracking and management.

order_status.description: Current lifecycle status of the order, representing phases such as pending, completed, or cancelled.

payment_status.description: Current payment state corresponding to this order.

total_amount.description: Total monetary amount for the entire order including taxes and shipping.

shipping_address.description: Serialized shipping address information captured at the time the order was placed.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this order was created in the system.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this order was last updated.

deleted_at.description: Optional timestamp representing soft deletion; null if order is active.

IShoppingMallOrderItem.description:
Represents a purchased product variant (order item) within a shopping mall order.

Includes detailed quantity and pricing information along with references to the parent order and product variant involved in the purchase.

This schema supports both retrieval of existing order item data and reflects the database structure within the API contract.

Each property corresponds exactly to the shopping_mall_order_items table columns with appropriate data types and constraints.

Used in retrieval, creation, update, and listing of order items within orders.

id.description: Unique identifier of the order item.

shopping_mall_order_id.description: UUID of the shopping mall order this item belongs to.

shopping_mall_product_variant_id.description: UUID of the product variant being purchased in this order item.

quantity.description: Number of units of the product variant purchased in this order item. Must be a positive integer.

unit_price.description: Price per unit of the product variant at the time of purchase, captured to maintain historical price accuracy. Must be zero or a positive value.

total_price.description: Total price for this order line calculated as quantity multiplied by unit price, used for invoicing and financial reconciliation. Must be zero or a positive value.

IShoppingMallPayment.description:
Represents a payment record in the shopping mall payment system.

Each payment record stores details about the payment method, payment status, transaction amount, external transaction tracking ID, and timestamps.

The payment is uniquely linked to a shopping mall order via a one-to-one relation by shopping_mall_order_id.

Soft deletion is supported by the optional deleted_at timestamp.

This schema is used for detailed payment retrieval, creation, and update operations.

Each property strictly corresponds to the shopping_mall_payments table columns with accurate data types and constraints.

Used by administrative and seller actors to process and query payments.

id.description: Unique identifier of the payment record.

shopping_mall_order_id.description: The ID of the associated shopping mall order.

payment_method.description: Payment method used (e.g., credit card, PayPal).

payment_status.description: Current status of the payment transaction.

payment_amount.description: The amount paid in this transaction. Must be a non-negative number.

transaction_id.description: External payment gateway transaction identifier for reference and tracking. Must be unique.

payment_date.description: Date and time when the payment was processed in ISO 8601 format.

created_at.description: Record creation timestamp in ISO 8601 format.

updated_at.description: Record last update timestamp in ISO 8601 format.

deleted_at.description: Soft delete timestamp indicating when the record was deleted, or null if active.

IShoppingMallShipment.description:
Represents a shipment record in the shopping mall, capturing shipping carrier, tracking information, shipment status, and relationships to an order.

The shipment entity tracks the shipping process of a customer order, including when the shipment was dispatched and delivered. Soft cancellation or modification of shipment records is supported through dedicated operations.

This object is used in detailed shipment retrieval responses and summaries.

id.description: Unique identifier for the shipment record.

shopping_mall_order_id.description: The unique identifier of the order associated with this shipment.

shipping_carrier.description: Name of the shipping carrier responsible for this shipment.

tracking_number.description: Tracking number assigned by the shipping carrier for shipment tracking.

oneOf.description: Current status of the shipment within the shipping lifecycle.
Current status of the shipment within the shipping lifecycle.
Current status of the shipment within the shipping lifecycle.
Current status of the shipment within the shipping lifecycle.
Current status of the shipment within the shipping lifecycle.

status.description: Current status of the shipment within the shipping lifecycle.

shipped_at.description: Timestamp when the shipment was shipped, in ISO 8601 format. Nullable if not shipped yet.

delivered_at.description: Timestamp when the shipment was delivered, in ISO 8601 format. Nullable if not delivered yet.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the shipment record was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the shipment record was last updated.

id.description: Unique customer identifier.

email.description: Email address of the customer.

IShoppingMallCustomer.ISummary.description: Summary information about a shopping mall customer.

id.description: Unique identifier for the order.

order_number.description: Unique order reference number for business tracking.

order_status.description: Current status of the order indicating its lifecycle phase.

payment_status.description: Status of the payment associated with the order.

total_amount.description: Total monetary amount of the order including taxes and shipping.

shipping_address.description: Serialized shipping address at the time of order placement.

created_at.description: Order creation timestamp.

updated_at.description: Last update timestamp for the order.

deleted_at.description: Optional soft delete timestamp to mark the order as deleted.

shopping_mall_customer.description: Summary information about the customer who placed the order.

shopping_mall_seller.description: Summary information about the seller responsible for order fulfillment.

IShoppingMallOrder.ISummary.description: Summary representation of a customer's order including key business details and reference to customer and seller.

shopping_mall_product_variant_id.description: Unique identifier of the purchased product variant (SKU) being added to the order. This must reference an existing product variant in the catalog.

quantity.description: Quantity of the product variant to be ordered. Must be a positive integer.

unit_price.description: Unit price for this SKU at the time of order placement. The price per single unit of the product variant.

total_price.description: Total price for this line item, equal to quantity multiplied by unit price. This is a calculated value and must match quantity * unit_price.

IShoppingMallOrderItem.ICreate.description:
Request body schema to create a new order item within a shopping mall order.

This includes specifying the product variant ID (SKU), quantity, unit price, and total price.

Actor identity fields such as order ID are derived from the path and authentication context and must not be included in the request body.

IShoppingMallOrderItem.IRequest.description:
Parameters for filtering, sorting, and paginating shopping mall order items.

This request schema supports specifying various criteria to narrow down the list of order items associated with a particular order. It includes pagination control fields and filtering options on product variants, quantities, and pricing to optimize data retrieval and presentation.

page.description: Current page number for paginated results, starting at 1.

limit.description: Maximum number of order item entries to return per page.

search.description: Full-text search string applied to product variant names or attributes to filter relevant order items.

oneOf.description: Field by which to sort order items, such as quantity, unit_price, or total_price.
Field by which to sort order items, such as quantity, unit_price, or total_price.
Field by which to sort order items, such as quantity, unit_price, or total_price.

sort_by.description: Field by which to sort order items, such as quantity, unit_price, or total_price.

oneOf.description: Direction of sorting, either ascending or descending.
Direction of sorting, either ascending or descending.

order.description: Direction of sorting, either ascending or descending.

quantity.description: Updated quantity of the product variant in the order item. Must be a positive integer if provided.

unit_price.description: Updated unit price for the SKU. This reflects any changes in pricing at the time of update.

total_price.description: Updated total price for the order item line, equal to quantity multiplied by unit price. Must remain consistent with quantity and unit price changes.

IShoppingMallOrderItem.IUpdate.description:
Request body schema to update details of an existing shopping mall order item.

Allows modifications to quantity, unit price, and total price fields.

Actor and ownership identifiers are managed by the backend and must not be present in the request body.

All fields are optional and if omitted, no changes are applied.

IShoppingMallPayment.IRequest.description:
Search criteria and pagination parameters for filtering payment records.

This request schema supports advanced filtering options such as filtering by payment method, payment status, payment amount ranges, and payment date ranges.

Enables clients to perform paginated search queries over payment transactions in the shopping mall system.

page.description: Page number for pagination. Defaults to 1 if not specified.

limit.description: Number of records per page. Controls the size of the result set.

payment_method.description: Filter payments by payment method, such as 'credit_card', 'paypal', etc.

payment_status.description: Filter payments by their status, e.g., 'completed', 'pending', 'failed'.

payment_amount_min.description: Minimum amount for payment filtering, inclusive.

payment_amount_max.description: Maximum amount for payment filtering, inclusive.

payment_date_from.description: Start date for payment date filtering, inclusive.

payment_date_to.description: End date for payment date filtering, inclusive.

IShoppingMallPayment.ICreate.description:
Request DTO for creating a new payment record associated with a shopping mall order.

This type is used in POST requests to create payment information linking to an existing order. It excludes read-only fields like id and timestamps.
Authentication context (admin or seller) injects actor identity as needed externally.

Includes properties to capture payment method, status, amount, external transaction ID, and payment date.

The payment_date indicates when the payment was processed, supporting audit and tracking.

Strict uniqueness enforced on transaction_id to prevent duplicate payments.

shopping_mall_order_id.description: Unique identifier of the order associated with this payment. This links the payment to the correct shopping mall order and ensures referential integrity.

payment_method.description: Method of payment used by the customer such as credit card, PayPal, or other third-party services. Ensures clear classification of transaction type.

payment_status.description: Current status of the payment transaction, for example, completed, pending, failed, or refunded. This status helps in tracking payment lifecycle and handling business logic related to payment processing.

payment_amount.description: The amount paid in this transaction specified in the mall's currency unit. Must be a non-negative value to represent currency accurately.

transaction_id.description: External payment gateway transaction identifier. Must be unique to avoid duplicate processing of the same payment.

payment_date.description: ISO 8601 format datetime representing when the payment was processed by the payment service. This timestamp supports financial record-keeping and auditing.

IShoppingMallPayment.IUpdate.description:
Request DTO for updating existing payment record fields in the shopping mall payment system.

Used in PUT requests to modify details such as payment method, payment status, amount, transaction ID, and payment date.

The payment record identity and linkage to orders are immutable and excluded from update payload.

Read-only timestamps like created_at and deleted_at are also excluded from updates.

Concurrency and uniqueness constraints ensure data integrity during updates.

payment_method.description: Updated method of payment used by the customer, allowing correction or change in payment method information.

payment_status.description: Updated status of the payment transaction reflecting the current lifecycle stage such as completed, pending, failed, or refunded.

payment_amount.description: Updated amount paid, representing any adjustments or corrections to the previous payment amount.

IShoppingMallOrderCancellation.description:
Order cancellation requests submitted by customers in the shopping mall platform.

This entity tracks all cancellation requests made by customers for their orders, including reasons for cancellation, current status, and important timestamps for request and processing.

Each cancellation is linked to an original order record, establishing a critical reference relationship. This data structure supports order management workflows and customer service processes to handle cancellations consistently and auditable.

The entity includes system-managed timestamps for creation, update, and soft deletion marking, supporting effective lifecycle management and historical data retention.

id.description: Unique identifier for the order cancellation request.

shopping_mall_order_id.description: Identifier of the shopping mall order associated with this cancellation. This establishes the reference to the original order that is requested to be cancelled.

cancellation_reason.description: The customer's provided reason for requesting the cancellation of the order, capturing the customer's intent and justification.

cancellation_status.description: The current status of the cancellation request, tracking its progression through various states such as requested, approved, rejected, or processed.

requested_at.description: The ISO 8601 timestamp when the cancellation request was initially submitted by the customer.

processed_at.description: The ISO 8601 timestamp when the cancellation request was processed by the system or staff. This is nullable, indicating unprocessed requests.

created_at.description: The timestamp when this record was created in the database, managed by the system.

updated_at.description: The timestamp indicating the last time this record was updated.

deleted_at.description: Soft delete timestamp marking when this record was logically removed. Nullable to indicate active records.

IShoppingMallOrderCancellation.ICreate.description:
Data required for creating a new order cancellation request in the shopping mall system.

This schema defines the properties expected in the request body when a customer submits a cancellation, including the cancellation reason and related order reference.

Sensitive or system-managed fields such as status, timestamps, and identifiers are not included here, as they are set by the system during processing.

shopping_mall_order_id.description: UUID of the original order associated with this cancellation request.

cancellation_reason.description: Customer's reason explaining why the order is being cancelled.

requested_at.description: Timestamp marking when the cancellation was requested. The client should provide this value in ISO 8601 format.

IShoppingMallOrderCancellation.IUpdate.description:
Data for updating an existing order cancellation request in the shopping mall platform.

Contains properties that can be modified after creation, such as cancellation status, reason, and processing timestamps. Immutable fields and identifiers are excluded to maintain data integrity.

This schema should be used for PUT operations on existing cancellation records and enforces validation on modifiable fields.

cancellation_reason.description: The reason for cancellation as updated by the customer or the system.

cancellation_status.description: Updated status of the cancellation request, representing workflow progression.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when the cancellation was processed or handled. Nullable if not yet processed.

IShoppingMallRefundRequest.description:
Represents a refund request made by a customer for an order in the shopping mall platform.

Tracks details such as the refund amount requested, reason for refund, current status of the refund process, timestamps for request and processing, and soft deletion metadata.

The refund request is linked to a specific order via its unique identifier and contains audit timestamps to support traceability and historical records.

Used in retrieving refund request data in responses.

id.description: Unique identifier for the refund request.

shopping_mall_order_id.description: Identifier of the order associated with this refund request.

refund_amount.description: The amount requested for refund in the order's currency.

refund_reason.description: Detailed reason provided by the customer for requesting the refund.

refund_status.description: Current processing status of the refund request. Typical statuses include 'pending', 'approved', 'rejected', or 'processed'.

requested_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp indicating when the refund was requested by the customer.

processed_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp indicating when the refund was processed. Null if not yet processed.

created_at.description: Timestamp marking when this refund request record was created in the system.

updated_at.description: Timestamp marking when this refund request record was last updated.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp marking when this refund request record was soft-deleted. Null if still active.

IShoppingMallRefundRequest.ICreate.description:
Payload used to create a new refund request linked to a specific order.

The refund amount and reason must be specified by the customer. The order identifier links the refund to an existing completed order.

The refund status and timestamps such as created_at, updated_at, processed_at, and deleted_at are managed internally by the system and must not be provided by the client.

Authentication context injects the customer identity; thus, no actor ID fields are included here.

shopping_mall_order_id.description: UUID of the order the refund is requested for.

refund_amount.description: Amount of money requested to be refunded for the order.

refund_reason.description: Customer's explanation for requesting a refund.

IShoppingMallRefundRequest.IUpdate.description: All fields are optional; only fields to be updated need to be specified.

refund_amount.description: Updated refund amount requested by the customer or operator.

refund_status.description: Current status of the refund request, reflecting business workflow stages such as 'pending', 'approved', 'rejected'.

processed_at.description: Date and time when the refund was processed or null if not processed yet.

IShoppingMallCoupon.IRequest.description:
Search and pagination parameters for filtering coupons.

Allows specifying coupon code, type, validity date range, and deletion status to filter coupon listings.

Includes fields for page number, page size, and sort order to support paginated API responses.

IShoppingMallCoupon.description:
Coupon definitions for promotional campaigns.

Represents coupons issued by the shopping mall platform to provide discounts or benefits to customers. Each coupon has a unique code, discount type, and validity period. Soft deletion is supported to preserve coupon history without permanent deletion.

Used for managing promotional discount campaigns applied across the shopping mall.

This is the main entity representing the coupon resource.

id.description: Unique identifier of the coupon.

code.description: Unique code identifying the coupon for redemption.

type.description: Type of coupon, e.g., percentage discount, fixed amount, free shipping.

discount_value.description: Value of the discount applied when the coupon is used.

start_date.description: Start date and time from which the coupon is valid.

end_date.description: End date and time until which the coupon is valid.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this coupon was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this coupon was last updated.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp marking soft deletion of the coupon; null if active.

code.description: Unique code identifying the coupon for redemption. Must be unique across the platform to prevent duplication and fraud.

type.description: Type of coupon defining the discount method, e.g., percentage discount, fixed amount, free shipping.

discount_value.description: Numeric value representing the discount applied when the coupon is used. Interpretation depends on the coupon type; for percentage discounts, represents percent value, for fixed amount, the currency amount.

start_date.description: The start date and time from which the coupon is valid. Must be a valid ISO 8601 timestamp.

end_date.description: The end date and time until which the coupon is valid. Must be after start_date and a valid ISO 8601 timestamp.

IShoppingMallCoupon.ICreate.description:
Schema for creating a new coupon in the shopping mall system.

Includes all mandatory properties required for coupon creation, such as unique code, coupon type, discount value, and validity period. The creation payload excludes managed fields such as timestamps and soft deletion markers since those are automatically handled by the system.

code.description: Unique code identifying the coupon for redemption. Updating the code requires ensuring uniqueness across the platform.

type.description: Coupon type defining the discount method, e.g., percentage, fixed amount, or free shipping. Updating this affects how discount_value is interpreted.

discount_value.description: Updated discount value applied with this coupon. Depends on coupon type.

start_date.description: Updated start date from which the coupon is valid. Must maintain chronological validity with end_date.

end_date.description: Updated end date until which the coupon is valid. Must remain after start_date.

IShoppingMallCoupon.IUpdate.description:
Schema for updating an existing coupon identified by its unique code.

Allows modifying key coupon properties with necessary validations ensuring uniqueness and date validity. Soft deletion is managed separately and cannot be altered here.

IShoppingMallCoupon.ISummary.description:
Summary information for shopping mall coupons.

Represents a concise view of coupon details used for listing and reference purposes.
Includes key identifying fields such as code, type, discount value, and validity period.
Excludes detailed or usage-specific data for efficiency.

This schema is used in responses where summarized coupon information is needed.

code.description: Unique code identifying the coupon for redemption.

discount_value.description: Value of the discount applied when the coupon is used.

start_date.description: Start date and time from which the coupon is valid.

end_date.description: End date and time until which the coupon is valid.

IShoppingMallCouponUsage.IRequest.description:
Request DTO for searching and filtering coupon usage records within the shopping mall platform.

This schema defines the search criteria, pagination options, and sorting parameters that clients use to query paginated coupon usage data for administrative review and analytics.

It enables filtering by coupon identifier, customer identifier, order linkage, usage timestamps, and supports pagination and sorting to optimize browsing through large datasets.

IShoppingMallCouponUsage.description:
Represents a record of a coupon usage by a customer in the shopping mall platform.

This entity tracks the usage of promotional coupons, linking to the specific coupon, customer, and customer session during which the coupon was redeemed. It provides auditability including timestamps for creation, update, and soft deletion.

All references to coupons, customers, and sessions ensure the relationships are maintained for accurate historical records and reporting.

id.description: Unique identifier of the coupon usage record.

shopping_mall_coupon.description: Summary information of the coupon being used.

shopping_mall_customer.description: Summary information of the customer who used the coupon.

shopping_mall_customer_session.description: Summary of the customer session in which the coupon was used.

used_at.description: Timestamp when the coupon usage occurred.

order_id.description: Order associated with this coupon usage, if any.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the coupon usage record was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the coupon usage record was last updated.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp marking soft deletion of the coupon usage; null if active.

IShoppingMallCouponUsage.ICreate.description:
Data required to create a new coupon usage record.

This schema excludes the auto-generated 'id', system timestamps, and all ownership reference fields, which are set automatically by the system or derived from the authenticated actor.

Clients must provide coupon ID and usage timestamp. Order ID is optional and may be null.

Authentication fields 'shopping_mall_customer_id' and 'shopping_mall_customer_session_id' have been removed to prevent client impersonation and session hijacking vulnerabilities.

Security restrictions exclude modification of audit fields and protected references.

shopping_mall_coupon_id.description: Identifier of the coupon being used.

used_at.description: Timestamp when the coupon usage occurred.

Data fields allowed for update of the coupon usage record.

Includes mutable fields such as usage timestamp and order linkage. System-managed audit fields like updated_at are excluded from client modification.

Ownership and identity fields are immutable and thus omitted.

Security restrictions ensure only authorized personnel can perform updates.

used_at.description: Updated timestamp when the coupon usage occurred.

order_id.description: Updated order ID associated with this coupon usage, if any.

IShoppingMallMileage.IRequest.description:
Request parameters for searching and paginating mileage records.

Supports filters for customer ID, point range, expiration status, and active records.

Includes pagination fields for page number and size, and sorting options.

IShoppingMallMileage.description:
Represents a mileage record associated with a shopping mall customer.

This entity stores information about reward points accrued by customers through purchases and activities within the shopping mall system. It supports tracking the points balance, optional expiration dates of points, and audit timestamps for creation, updates, and soft deletion.

Each mileage record references exactly one shopping mall customer by their unique identifier. The design enforces strict ownership and security, ensuring that mileage points modifications by customers are authenticated and authorized.

id.description: Unique identifier for the mileage record.

shopping_mall_customer_id.description: The unique identifier of the customer who owns this mileage record.

points.description: Total number of mileage points accumulated in this record.

expiration_date.description: The expiration date of these mileage points, if any. Null means points do not expire.

created_at.description: Timestamp indicating when the mileage record was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp indicating the last time the mileage record was updated.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp marking when the mileage record was soft deleted, or null if the record is active.

IShoppingMallMileage.ICreate.description:
Data required to create a new mileage record associated with a shopping mall customer.

This create DTO excludes the `shopping_mall_customer_id` field because the current authenticated customer actor is injected by the server and must not be provided by the client.

Clients should provide the number of points to assign and optionally an expiration date for the points.

Timestamps and id are system-generated and excluded from the creation payload.

The design enforces security by removing sensitive and ownership fields from client input.

points.description: The number of mileage points to add in this new record. Must be a positive integer.

expiration_date.description: Optional expiration date for the mileage points. A null value means the points do not expire.

IShoppingMallMileage.IUpdate.description:
Data allowed to update an existing mileage record. Provides the ability to modify points and expiration date.

The current authenticated customer is the actor and thus must not provide any ownership related fields.

Timestamps are system-managed and excluded from updates.

Properties are optional to support partial updates, with explicit null allowed for the expiration_date field.

points.description: Updated number of mileage points for this record, if applicable. Must remain a positive integer.

expiration_date.description: The updated expiration date of the mileage points. Null clears existing expiration.

Summary view of customer mileage points in the shopping mall reward program.

Represents key information about accumulated mileage points, including point balance and basic ownership details. Intended for list views and brief displays where detailed mileage history is not required.

Excludes detailed timestamps and sensitive audit fields.

All relationships are represented by identifiers or summary references as applicable.

Tracks customer point balances for loyalty rewards in the shopping mall.

IShoppingMallPoint.description:
Customer loyalty points record.

Represents a customer's current balance of loyalty points within the shopping mall platform. Use these points to track earned, redeemed, and adjusted loyalty rewards as part of promotional programs.

The field `shopping_mall_customer_id` has been removed for external API exposure as it is intended for internal use only and should not be exposed in client-facing interfaces.

Security is critical, and modifications to point balances are restricted to authorized admin users to prevent fraudulent activities.

Timestamps track the lifecycle of the points record, including creation time, last update time, and optional soft deletion time for record deactivation.
