moderation_status.description: Current moderation status: pending, approved, rejected.

updated_at.description: Last modification timestamp of the review.

IShoppingMallProductReview.IUpdate.description:
Request DTO to update an existing shopping mall product review.

Allows modification of rating, title, content, and moderation status fields.
Ownership and author fields are immutable and excluded.
Timestamps reflect the last update time managed by the system.

page.description: Page number for pagination, defaults to first page if omitted.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return per page.

sort_by.description: Field name to sort by, e.g., created_at, updated_at.

oneOf.description: Sort order: ascending or descending.
Sort order: ascending or descending.

filter_moderation_action.description: Filter moderation records by action type, e.g., approved, rejected, flagged.

IShoppingMallReviewModeration.IRequest.description:
Request parameters to search and retrieve shopping mall review moderation records.

Supports pagination, sorting, and filtering by moderation action type.

IShoppingMallReviewModeration.description:
Moderation records for product reviews to enforce content guidelines and compliance.

Each entry references a specific review and records the moderator admin who performed the action, the action taken, and any relevant comments.

Soft deletion is supported to allow audit trails while maintaining historical data integrity.

id.description: Primary Key - unique identifier of the moderation record.

shoppingMallProductReviewId.description: The product review being moderated. Foreign key referencing shopping_mall_product_reviews.id.

shoppingMallAdminId.description: Admin who performed the moderation action. Foreign key referencing shopping_mall_admins.id.

action.description: Moderation action taken, e.g., approved, rejected, flagged.

oneOf.description: Optional comment explaining the moderation decision.

comment.description: Optional comment explaining the moderation decision.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the moderation action was performed.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last update on this moderation record.

deletedAt.description: Soft deletion timestamp, null if not deleted.

admin.description: The admin user who performed the moderation action.

IShoppingMallReviewModeration.ICreate.description:
Data required to create a moderation record for a product review.

Includes the moderation action and optional comments. The related product review is specified by the API path parameter.

Admin identification comes from the authenticated context and MUST NOT be included here.

action.description: Moderation action to perform, e.g., approved, rejected, flagged.

oneOf.description: Optional explanatory comment for the moderation decision.

comment.description: Optional explanatory comment for the moderation decision.

IShoppingMallReviewModeration.IUpdate.description: Properties allowed for updating a shopping mall review moderation record. This structure supports modifying moderation actions, comments, and timestamps while excluding primary identifier fields to preserve data integrity and audit trails.

action.description: Moderation action taken, such as approved, rejected, or flagged.

comment.description: Optional comment explaining the moderation decision. Can be null to indicate no comment.

IShoppingMallCustomerQuestion.IRequest.description: Search criteria and pagination parameters for filtering shopping mall customer questions. Supports advanced querying by title, body, customer and session IDs, with options for sorting and pagination to efficiently manage large datasets.

page.description: The page number for paginated results, starting at 1.

limit.description: Number of results to return per page. Must be a positive integer.

searchTitle.description: Text string to search within question titles.

searchBody.description: Text string to search within question bodies.

shoppingMallCustomerSessionId.description: Filter to match questions associated with a specific customer session, identified by UUID.

createdBefore.description: Filter to include questions created before this timestamp.

createdAfter.description: Filter to include questions created after this timestamp.

oneOf.description: Field by which to sort the results.
Field by which to sort the results.
Field by which to sort the results.

sortBy.description: Field by which to sort the results.

oneOf.description: Sort order, ascending or descending.
Sort order, ascending or descending.

id.description: Primary key, uniquely identifying each customer question.

shopping_mall_customer_id.description: Foreign key referencing the customer who asked the question. Links to the shopping_mall_customers entity.

shopping_mall_customer_session_id.description: Foreign key referencing the customer's active session when the question was asked.

title.description: The title or summary of the question content, providing a brief overview of the inquiry.

body.description: Detailed body text elaborating on the customer's question or concern.

created_at.description: Timestamp indicating when the question was initially created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp indicating when the question was last updated.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp indicating when the question was soft deleted, if applicable. Null if the question is active.

IShoppingMallCustomerQuestion.description: Represents a question submitted by a customer in the shopping mall system, including references to the customer and session, content fields, timestamps, and soft deletion status. This entity supports customer inquiry management and moderation workflows.

IShoppingMallCustomerQuestion.ICreate.description: Schema for creating a new customer question. Includes question title and body. The customer and session IDs are derived from authentication context and are not included in the request body.

title.description: The title or summary of the question content, providing a brief overview of the inquiry.

body.description: Detailed body text elaborating on the customer's question or concern.

IShoppingMallCustomerQuestion.IUpdate.description:
Data for updating an existing customer question.

Allows modification of the title and body of the question. The update maintains references to the owning customer and session implicitly through authentication context, so related identity fields are excluded from updates.

System-managed timestamps are excluded from updates and handled automatically.

title.description: The updated title or summary of the customer's question.

body.description: The updated detailed body text of the customer's question.

IShoppingMallQuestionAnswer.IRequest.description:
Parameters for filtering, sorting, and pagination when retrieving seller answers to a customer question.

Used to page through potentially multiple seller responses for a specific customer question.

Includes pagination controls, search filters, and sorting options.

page.description: Page number for paginated results. Defaults to 1 if not specified.

limit.description: Number of items per page to retrieve. Defaults to 20 if not specified.

search.description: Search query to filter answers based on title or body content.

order_by.description: Field name to sort the answers by, such as 'created_at' or 'title'.

oneOf.description: Direction of sorting: 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending.
Direction of sorting: 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending.

order_direction.description: Direction of sorting: 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending.

IShoppingMallQuestionAnswer.description:
Represents an answer provided by a seller in response to a customer question within the shopping mall platform.

Each answer is uniquely linked to a specific customer question and created by an authenticated seller. It contains title, body content, and auditing timestamps.

Supports soft deletion and audit trails to track creation and modification events. This entity ensures clear communication between customers and sellers through direct answers.

Relationships:
- References the customer question by its unique ID.
- Linked to the seller who provided the answer via their authenticated session.

Security:
- Seller identity fields are excluded from client input and added by the server from authentication context.

id.description: Primary key unique identifier for the seller answer.

shopping_mall_customer_question_id.description: UUID of the customer question being answered, linking the answer to the corresponding question.

shopping_mall_seller_id.description: UUID of the seller who authored the answer.

shopping_mall_seller_session_id.description: UUID of the seller's active session when the answer was provided, useful for audit and traceability.

title.description: Title or headline summarizing the seller's answer.

body.description: Detailed textual content of the seller's answer providing necessary information or clarification to the customer's question.

created_at.description: Timestamp indicating when the answer was initially created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp indicating the last time the answer was modified or updated.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp marking when the answer was softly deleted; null if the answer is active.

IShoppingMallQuestionAnswer.ICreate.description:
Request payload schema for creating a new seller answer to a customer question in the shopping mall platform.

Contains fields for the answer's title and body text. The seller ID and session ID are inferred from the authenticated context and must not be included by the client.

Security:
- Seller identity fields are excluded to prevent spoofing.
- Creation and update timestamps are managed by the system and not accepted here.

Relationships:
- Requires a reference to the customer question by its ID via the endpoint path parameter, not in the request body.

title.description: Title or headline summarizing the seller's answer.

body.description: Detailed textual content of the seller's answer providing necessary information or clarification to the customer's question.

IShoppingMallQuestionAnswer.IUpdate.description:
Request body schema for updating a shopping mall question answer record by a seller.

Contains mutable fields that the seller is allowed to modify, including title and body text of the answer.
Ownership and linkage fields are excluded, as they are derived from path parameters or authentication context.
Timestamps can be included for update tracking.

title.description: The title or headline of the answer provided by the seller in response to a customer question. It should be concise and clearly summarize the answer's content.

body.description: Detailed body text of the seller's answer. This field contains the explanation or response to the customer's inquiry, providing complete and clear information.

created_at.description: Timestamp indicating when the answer was originally created. This is useful for audit trails.

updated_at.description: Timestamp indicating when the answer was last updated. Updated when the seller modifies the answer.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp indicating when the answer was soft deleted, if applicable. Null means the answer is active.

IShoppingMallSupportTicket.IRequest.description:
Search and pagination parameters for querying shopping mall support tickets.

Allows clients to filter tickets by status, submitter, date ranges, and supports sorting and pagination.
Supports complex search criteria on titles and descriptions with full-text search indexes.

This request DTO is designed for PATCH method usage, allowing detailed filtering fields.

page.description: Page number of the paginated results to retrieve. Defaults to 1 if not specified.

limit.description: Number of results per page in the paginated response. Defaults to 20 if not specified.

search.description: Full-text search string filtering tickets on title and description fields.

status.description: Current status of the support tickets to filter by. Common values include 'open', 'in_progress', 'resolved', and 'closed'.

submitter_type.description: Optional filter for the submitter type, restricting results to either 'customer' or 'seller'.

created_from.description: Filter results to tickets created on or after this timestamp.

created_to.description: Filter results to tickets created on or before this timestamp.

updated_from.description: Filter results to tickets updated on or after this timestamp.

updated_to.description: Filter results to tickets updated on or before this timestamp.

IShoppingMallSupportTicket.description:
Support tickets submitted by customers or sellers to report issues or requests within the ShoppingMall platform.

This entity captures detailed ticket information including title, description, and current status to facilitate the support process.
Each ticket is associated with a submitting customer or seller user and their session context when applicable.
Tickets track timestamps for creation, updates, and soft deletion to support audit and moderation workflows.

Used for managing customer and seller support inquiries, enabling swift resolution and tracking via the ShoppingMall support system.

id.description: Unique identifier for the support ticket.

title.description: Subject or summary of the support ticket issue or request.

description.description: Detailed explanation of the issue or support request provided by the submitter.

status.description: Current status of the support ticket, indicating progress such as open, in_progress, resolved, or closed.

shopping_mall_customer_id.description: Reference to the customer who submitted the ticket, if applicable. Nullable for tickets submitted by sellers.

shopping_mall_seller_id.description: Reference to the seller who submitted the ticket, if applicable. Nullable for tickets submitted by customers.

shopping_mall_customer_session_id.description: Identifier of the customer session during ticket submission, if applicable.

shopping_mall_seller_session_id.description: Identifier of the seller session during ticket submission, if applicable.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the support ticket was initially created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the support ticket was last updated.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the support ticket was soft deleted, if applicable. Nullable to represent non-deleted tickets.

IShoppingMallRole.IRequest.description:
Search criteria and pagination parameters for filtering system roles within the shopping mall platform.

This schema allows administrators to specify search terms, sorting options, and pagination settings to retrieve tailored subsets of shopping mall roles. It supports filtering by role name and label while facilitating efficient browsing and management of roles.

page.description: Page number for pagination starting from 1.

limit.description: Number of items to retrieve per page to control paging size and performance.

searchTerm.description: Text search term for filtering roles by name, label, or description.

sortField.description: Field used for sorting the role results, e.g., 'name' or 'created_at'.

oneOf.description: Sort order direction, ascending or descending.
Sort order direction, ascending or descending.

sortDirection.description: Sort order direction, ascending or descending.

IShoppingMallRole.description:
System roles defining sets of permissions for access control within the shopping mall platform.

Represents roles used for grouping privileges and managing user rights across the platform. Each role has a unique internal name, a human-readable label, and an optional detailed description explaining the role's purpose and scope.

Roles are fundamental for scalable permission management and administrative control within the shopping mall system.

id.description: Unique identifier of the shopping mall role.

name.description: Unique role identifier name used internally.

label.description: Human-readable label describing the role's purpose.

description.description: Detailed description of the role's permissions and context. Nullable field.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the role was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the role was last updated.

IShoppingMallRole.ICreate.description:
Data required to create a new shopping mall role.

Includes the unique internal name of the role and its human-readable label. An optional description can be provided to detail the permissions and purpose of the role.

System-generated fields like id, timestamps, and any security tokens are not accepted during creation.

Creation requires administrative authorization.

name.description: Unique role identifier name used internally for this role.

description.description: Optional detailed description outlining the role's permissions and context.

IShoppingMallRole.IUpdate.description:
Data allowed for updating an existing shopping mall role.

Allows modification of the human-readable label and detailed description of the role. The unique name of the role cannot be changed.

Administrative authorization is required. System-generated fields and unique identifiers are excluded from update operations.

label.description: Updated human-readable label describing the role's purpose.

description.description: Updated detailed description of the role's permissions and context.

IShoppingMallUserRole.IRequest.description:
Request DTO for searching and paginating shopping mall user role assignments.

This type defines the possible parameters for filtering, sorting, and paginating user role association records in the shopping mall system.
It includes pagination fields, keyword search, filtering by admin user or role, and date range filters on creation and deletion timestamps.

It enables clients to specify criteria for retrieving a subset of user role assignments that match the search conditions.

This DTO is used as the request body in search/list API operations.

page.description: Page number for pagination starting from 1. Defaults to 1 if omitted.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return per page. Defaults to 10 if omitted. Used to control page size and limit data transfer.

keyword.description: Keyword string to perform text search across relevant user role assignment fields.

shopping_mall_admin_id.description: Filter to include only user role assignments assigned to a specific administrator, identified by their UUID.

shopping_mall_role_id.description: Filter to include only user role assignments that have a specific role assigned, identified by their UUID.

created_at_start.description: Filter to include only records created on or after this date/time. ISO 8601 date-time string expected.

created_at_end.description: Filter to include only records created on or before this date/time. ISO 8601 date-time string expected.

deleted_at_start.description: Filter to include only records soft deleted on or after this date/time. ISO 8601 date-time string expected.

deleted_at_end.description: Filter to include only records soft deleted on or before this date/time. ISO 8601 date-time string expected.

IShoppingMallUserRole.ISummary.description:
Summary representation of the user role assigned to administrators within the shopping mall platform.

This schema provides key identification details of the user role mapping, including references to the associated administrator and role entities.

It is used for listing or embedding minimal user role info in other entities or operations.

id.description: Unique identifier of the user role mapping.

shopping_mall_admin_id.description: Identifier referencing the administrator user assigned this role. This field is a direct foreign key to the administrator entity.

shopping_mall_role_id.description: Identifier referencing the specific role assigned. This is a foreign key linking to the role entity defining permissions.

created_at.description: Timestamp indicating when this user role assignment was created.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp indicating when this role assignment was soft deleted, if applicable. Null if active.

IShoppingMallUserRole.description:
Detailed shopping mall user role assignment entity.

Represents the full data record linking an administrator user to a system role for managing permissions.
Includes creation and soft deletion timestamps to track assignment lifecycle.

This entity is used in detailed views and contains all database fields.

Ownership and system-managed fields are included as read-only.

Actor's identity fields are omitted from creation requests and injected automatically by the server.

id.description: Primary key: Unique identifier of the user role assignment.

shopping_mall_admin_id.description: Foreign key referencing the administrator user assigned this role.

shopping_mall_role_id.description: Foreign key referencing the system role assigned to the user.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this role assignment was created.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp marking soft deletion status if inactive, null otherwise.

IShoppingMallUserRole.ICreate.description:
Schema for creating a new shopping mall user role association, defining the linkage between users and their assigned roles for permission management.

Authentication context fields removed as they are set implicitly by the server and must not be included in requests.

shopping_mall_user_id.description: Unique identifier for the user in the shopping mall system.

shopping_mall_role_id.description: Unique identifier for the role being assigned to the user.

IShoppingMallUserRole.IUpdate.description:
Schema for updating an existing shopping mall user role association, allowing modification of user-role mappings.

Authentication context fields removed as they are set implicitly by the server and must not be included in requests.

shopping_mall_user_id.description: Unique identifier for the user in the shopping mall system.

shopping_mall_role_id.description: Unique identifier for the role being assigned to the user.

page.description: Page number for paginated results, starting from 1.

limit.description: Number of records to return per page. Limits response size.

search.description: Text search filter applied across permission name, label, and description.

sortBy.description: Field used to sort results. Allowed values include 'name', 'label', or 'created_at'.

oneOf.description: Sort order direction. Allowed values are 'asc' for ascending and 'desc' for descending.
Sort order direction. Allowed values are 'asc' for ascending and 'desc' for descending.

sortOrder.description: Sort order direction. Allowed values are 'asc' for ascending and 'desc' for descending.

IShoppingMallPermission.IRequest.description:
Request object for filtering and paginating shopping mall permissions.

This object supports search filtering by name, label, and description fields, pagination parameters, and ordering.

It is used in the admin API to retrieve paged permission data efficiently for management purposes.

IShoppingMallPermission.ICreate.description:
Schema for creating a new shopping mall permission entity. This create DTO requires the unique internal name and a human-readable label. Optionally details the permission's scope and usage.

Actor identity fields are excluded as they are injected server-side from authorized admin context.

name.description: Unique permission identifier used internally. Must be unique across all permissions.

label.description: Human-readable label describing the permission for UI display and documentation purposes.

description.description: Optional detailed description explaining the purpose, scope, and usage of this permission to provide clarity for administrators.

id.description: Unique identifier for the shopping mall permission record.

name.description:
Unique internal name of the permission used by the system for identification.

Must be unique and is immutable after creation.

label.description: Human-readable label presenting the permission in administrative user interfaces for easier recognition of permission purpose.

description.description:
Optional detailed description of the permission's scope, usage, and any constraints.

Provides additional context for administrators managing permissions.

created_at.description:
Timestamp of when the permission record was initially created.

Used for audit and historical tracking.

updated_at.description:
Timestamp of the most recent update to the permission record.

Reflects administrative changes for tracking purposes.

IShoppingMallPermission.description:
Represents a permission entity defining access rights within the shopping mall system.

Each permission includes a unique name, a descriptive label, and optional detailed description.

Permissions govern what administrative actions can be performed, enabling precise access control.

Timestamps assist with audit trails and administrative history tracking.

Used across administrative APIs for management and enforcement of role-based access control.

IShoppingMallAdminAuditLog.IRequest.description:
Parameters for filtering and paginating administrator audit logs on the shopping mall platform.

Supports filtering by action type, resource type, date range, success status, and other criteria to enable detailed audit log searches.

Includes pagination options such as page number and page size.

Administrators can use this to review historical actions for security and compliance.

page.description: Page number for pagination. Defaults to 1 if not provided.

limit.description: Number of records per page for pagination. Typical values range from 10 to 100.

action_type.description: Filter by the type of action performed by the admin (e.g., CREATE_USER). Optional.

resource_type.description: Filter by the type of resource affected by the action (e.g., user, product). Optional.

resource_id.description: Filter by the identifier of the affected resource. Optional.

success.description: Filter to include only successful or failed actions. Optional.

created_after.description: Filter audit logs created after this timestamp. Optional.

created_before.description: Filter audit logs created before this timestamp. Optional.

IShoppingMallAdminAuditLog.description:
Represents an immutable audit log entry recording an administrative action within the shopping mall platform.

Each entry captures detailed information about the action such as the administrator involved, the type of action, target resource, and success status, ensuring traceability, compliance, and security auditing.

Updates or deletions of these logs are disallowed to preserve historical integrity.

id.description: Unique identifier for the audit log entry.

shopping_mall_admin_id.description: Reference to the administrator who performed the action. This field links to the unique identifier of the shopping mall admin responsible for the operation.

action_type.description: The classification of action performed by the administrator, such as CREATE_USER, DELETE_PRODUCT, etc. This defines what operation was conducted.

resource_type.description: Indicates the type of resource affected by the action, such as user, product, or order, helping categorize the audit event.

resource_id.description: Optional identifier of the specific resource impacted by the action, if applicable. This field may be null when not directly related to a particular resource.

success.description: Boolean value indicating whether the administrative action was successful.

details.description: Optional JSON-formatted string containing additional context, metadata or diagnostic information about the action performed.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the audit log entry was created, recorded in ISO 8601 format.

IShoppingMallMvShoppingMallDailySale.IRe.description:
Request parameters to filter and paginate daily sales summary records from the materialized view mv_shopping_mall_daily_sales.

Allows precise querying by sales date range and supports paging through date-aggregated sales performance data.

This DTO includes optional filters enabling flexible analytical queries on daily sales statistics.

sales_date_from.description: The start of the sales date range filter (inclusive) in ISO 8601 date-time format. This defines the earliest date for daily sales summaries to include in the search. Null disables the lower bound filter.

sales_date_to.description: The end of the sales date range filter (inclusive) in ISO 8601 date-time format. This marks the latest date for daily sales summaries to include in the query results. Null disables the upper bound filter.

page.description: Page number for pagination, starting from 1. This controls which page of results to return.

limit.description: Maximum number of daily sales records to return per page. This caps the size of the result set for efficient paging.

IShoppingMallMvShoppingMallDailySale.description:
Represents a daily sales summary record from a materialized view aggregating sales data for the entire shopping mall platform.

This entity provides essential analytics data including total orders, total sales amount, and total items sold for each sales date.

The data is read-only and optimized for fast querying, supporting business monitoring and decision-making.

id.description: Unique identifier for the daily sales summary record.

sales_date.description: The specific date for which the sales data was aggregated, formatted in ISO 8601 date-time format.

total_orders.description: Total number of orders placed on the specified sales date.

total_sales_amount.description: Aggregate amount of sales in the platform's currency for that day.

total_items_sold.description: Total quantity of all items sold across all orders during the sales date.

IShoppingMallMvShoppingMallInventoryStat.description:
Request parameters for searching and paginating aggregated SKU inventory status in the mall.

Allows filtering by category, low stock alerts, and supports pagination for efficient client-side browsing of inventory data.

page.description: The page number of the paginated results to retrieve. Defaults typically to 1 if not specified.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return in one page of the paginated results. Limits help control response size.

sortBy.description: The field name by which the result set should be sorted. Example values might include 'category_name' or 'inventory_quantity'.

oneOf.description: Sort order direction: 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending.
Sort order direction: 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending.

sortOrder.description: Sort order direction: 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending.

filterCategoryId.description: Optional filter parameter to retrieve inventory status only for the specified product category.

filterLowStockOnly.description: If true, restricts results to only those inventory records where SKUs are below the defined low stock threshold.

IShoppingMallMvShoppingMallInventoryStat.description:
Detailed inventory status record representing aggregated SKU inventory information across the shopping mall.

This schema describes a single record from the materialized view that consolidates inventory counts, low stock alerts, and SKU aggregates per product category. It is designed for read-only consumption and fast inventory monitoring.

The record includes the category identifier relation, SKU counts, quantities, thresholds, and timestamps related to the view's refresh cycle.

id.description: Unique identifier of the inventory status record.

category_id.description: Unique identifier of the product category this inventory summary relates to.

total_sku_count.description: Total count of distinct SKUs under the product category.

total_inventory_quantity.description: Aggregate quantity of all SKU items currently available in stock within this category.

low_stock_threshold.description: Inventory level threshold to mark a SKU as low stock for alerting.

low_stock_sku_count.description: Number of SKUs below the low stock threshold in the category.

last_refreshed_at.description: Timestamp when this materialized view record was last refreshed.

IShoppingMallSystemConfiguration.ISummar.description:
Summary information for a system configuration parameter.

This schema describes minimal essential data for system configuration entries, including the unique key and description.
It excludes the full configuration value to limit exposure in summary contexts.

key.description: Unique key identifier of the system configuration parameter.

description.description: Explanation of the configuration setting's purpose and usage.

IShoppingMallCategoryHierarchy.ISummary.description:
Summary information about a hierarchical link between shopping mall categories.

Represents the parent-child relationship between two categories, enabling multi-level category tree structures in the catalog.

This schema is derived from the shopping_mall_category_hierarchies table and includes identifiers for both parent and child categories along with timestamps of record creation and update.

id.description: Unique identifier of the hierarchy relationship.

parent_category.description: Summary of the parent category linked in this hierarchy.

child_category.description: Summary of the child category linked in this hierarchy.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this hierarchy record was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this hierarchy record was last updated.

IShoppingMallGuest.ISummary.description:
Summary information of guest users browsing the e-commerce mall without authentication.

This schema provides essential identification and metadata useful for list views or reference usages in other entities.

Guests are anonymous users with limited interaction capabilities, mainly browsing the product catalog.

id.description: Unique identifier of the guest user.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the guest profile was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the guest profile was last updated.

IShoppingMallGuestSession.ISummary.description:
Summary information of guest user sessions representing connections to the platform.

Each session records connection context such as IP address, connection URL (href), and HTTP referrer for auditing and diagnostic purposes.

Sessions are linked to guest users enabling the tracking of multiple concurrent sessions per guest.

This summary schema provides key identification and session timing metadata.

id.description: Unique identifier of the guest session.

shopping_mall_guest_id.description: Foreign key identifying the guest user associated with this session.

ip.description: IP address from which the session was established.

href.description: URL accessed during session initiation.

referrer.description: HTTP referrer header value indicating the previous URL visited.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

expired_at.description: Timestamp when the session expires. Null if the session is currently active.

IShoppingMallCustomerSession.ISummary.description:
A concise summary of a shopping mall customer session capturing key connection details for authenticated sessions.

This provides essential metadata including IP address, connection URL, and referrer for auditing security and analytics in user session tracking.

Designed for embedding within summaries or response lists related to user sessions.

id.description: Unique identifier for the session record.

shopping_mall_customer_id.description: Reference to the owning customer of this session.

ip.description: IP address associated with the customer's session.

href.description: URL of the page where the session originated.

referrer.description: HTTP referrer header indicating previous page before the session started.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the session was created.

IShoppingMallSellerSession.ISummary.description: Summary information of an authenticated session for a shopping mall seller, providing basic session identification and connection details without revealing sensitive tokens or security data.

id.description: Unique identifier for the session.

seller_id.description: Identifier of the seller associated with this session.

ip_address.description: IP address from which the seller's session originated. Nullable if not available.

user_agent.description: User agent string identifying the client's browser or application. Nullable if not available.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the session was created.

last_active_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last activity in this session. Nullable if no activity since creation.

IShoppingMallProduct.ISummary.description:
Summary view of a product listed in the shopping mall platform.

This summary schema provides a concise set of essential product information suitable for lists and references, including unique identifiers, code, title, and category details.

It enables efficient display of product lists without detailed variant or full description information.

id.description: Unique identifier of the product. This is the primary key generated as a UUID and used to uniquely identify each product in the system.

code.description: Unique product code for business identification. This code is guaranteed unique across all products and often used for searching and referencing specific items.

title.description: The product's title used for display in listings, intended to be concise yet descriptive to help users identify the product quickly.

shopping_mall_category_id.description: Identifier of the category this product belongs to, enabling hierarchical organization and categorization of products in the shopping mall system.

created_at.description: Creation timestamp of the product record, stored in ISO 8601 format with timezone information to ensure consistency across distributed systems.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last update made to the product record. This is used for synchronization and cache invalidation purposes, formatted in ISO 8601.

id.description: Unique identifier of the product variant.

sku_code.description: SKU code of the product variant.

IShoppingMallProductVariant.ISummary.description: Summary information of a product variant (SKU) for display and reference.

IShoppingMallInventory.ISummary.description:
Summary view of shopping mall inventory records tracking SKU stock levels and availability.

Provides essential information about product variant stock quantity and reservation state to facilitate quick inventory checks in list views and aggregations.

This summary excludes detailed timestamps and soft deletion fields but maintains references to the relevant product variant.

id.description: Unique identifier for the inventory record.

shopping_mall_product_variant_id.description: Identifier referencing the product variant associated with this inventory.

quantity.description: Total quantity of stock available for this product variant.

reserved_quantity.description: Quantity of stock reserved for pending orders.

IShoppingMallProductSnapshot.ISummary.description:
Summary view of historical snapshots capturing shopping mall product data at specific points in time for audit and versioning.

Provides key snapshot information including the product code, title, snapshot timestamp, and creation date for rapid retrieval of past product details.

Does not include optional description or brand fields to keep summary lightweight.

id.description: Unique identifier for the product snapshot record.

shopping_mall_product_id.description: Identifier referencing the original shopping mall product associated with this snapshot.

code.description: Product code at the snapshot moment, used for identification and tracking.

title.description: Product title at the snapshot moment, representing the product's name at that point in time.

snapshot_at.description: Timestamp when this snapshot was created, indicating the exact point in time the product data was captured.

created_at.description: Record creation timestamp indicating when this snapshot entry was inserted into the system.

IShoppingMallCart.ISummary.description:
Summary representation of a shopping cart belonging to a customer in the shopping mall system.

Includes primary identifiers, ownership reference, status timestamps, and session linkage for audit and tracking.
This summary is used for efficient display in lists or references without detailed item information.

Relationships to customer and customer session are represented as identifiers only to avoid redundant loading.
Sensitive or internal management fields are excluded.

id.description: Primary unique identifier of the shopping cart.

shopping_mall_customer_id.description: UUID of the customer who owns this cart.

shopping_mall_customer_session_id.description: UUID of the customer session associated with this cart, nullable if not tied to a specific session.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the cart was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the cart was last updated.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp marking soft deletion; null if active.

IShoppingMallCartItem.ISummary.description:
Summary representation of an individual item within a shopping cart in the shopping mall system.

Includes product variant references, quantity, and timestamps relevant to item lifecycle.
Used for reference within cart item lists or other summary contexts.

Relationships to cart and product variants are represented as identifiers only to avoid redundant detailed object inclusion.

id.description: Primary unique identifier of the cart item.

shopping_mall_cart_id.description: UUID of the parent shopping cart.

shopping_mall_product_variant_id.description: UUID of the product variant (SKU) selected.

quantity.description: Quantity of the product variant selected by the customer.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the cart item was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the cart item was last updated.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp marking soft deletion; null if active.

IShoppingMallWishlistItem.ISummary.description:
Summary representation of an individual item in a customer's wishlist.

Includes the unique identifier, references to the parent wishlist and product variant (SKU), and timestamps for creation, update, and soft deletion.

Suitable for listing or referencing wishlist items without full detail of the product variant.

id.description: Unique identifier for the wishlist item.

shopping_mall_wishlist_id.description: Identifier of the wishlist this item belongs to.

shopping_mall_product_variant_id.description: Identifier of the associated product variant (SKU).

created_at.description: Timestamp when the wishlist item was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the wishlist item was last updated.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the wishlist item was soft deleted; null if active.

id.description: Unique identifier for the order item.

quantity.description: Quantity of the product variant purchased.

unit_price.description: Price per unit for this SKU at purchase time.

total_price.description: Total price for this line item (quantity multiplied by unit price).

shopping_mall_product_variant.description: Summary information about the product variant (SKU) purchased.

IShoppingMallOrderItem.ISummary.description: Summary representation of an order line item including quantity, pricing, and product variant.

IShoppingMallPayment.ISummary.description: Summary information for shopping mall payments, including key details for identification and status of payments processed in the system.

id.description: Unique identifier of the payment record.

order_id.description: Identifier of the associated order for which the payment was made.

status.description: Current status of the payment (e.g., pending, completed, failed).

payment_method.description: Method used for the payment (e.g., credit card, PayPal, bank transfer).

paid_at.description: Timestamp when the payment was completed.

IShoppingMallOrderCancellation.ISummary.description:
Summary information of customer-submitted order cancellation requests.

Represents the key data for each cancellation request including the associated order ID, the reason provided by the customer, current request status, and relevant timestamps.

Used primarily for overview and listing purposes, this summary excludes detailed processing metadata.

id.description: Unique identifier of the cancellation request.

shopping_mall_order_id.description: UUID of the order associated with this cancellation request.

cancellation_reason.description: Customer's provided reason for the order cancellation request.

cancellation_status.description: Current status of the cancellation request, reflecting processing progress and outcome.

requested_at.description: Timestamp when the cancellation request was submitted by the customer.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when the cancellation request was processed by the system, or null if not yet processed.

IShoppingMallCouponUsage.ISummary.description:
Summary information for coupon usage records.

Represents a concise view of coupon usage details including references to coupon and customer,
usability period, usage timestamp and associated order information.
Excludes system-managed timestamps and soft deletion details from summary.

Used primarily for listing coupon usage information with key contextual references.

id.description: Unique identifier of the coupon usage record.

shopping_mall_coupon_id.description: Reference ID of the coupon that was used.

shopping_mall_customer_id.description: Reference ID of the customer who used the coupon.

used_at.description: Timestamp when the coupon usage occurred.

order_id.description: Associated order ID if coupon usage is linked to a specific order; null otherwise.

IShoppingMallPoints.ISummary.description:
Summary view of customer points balance for loyalty rewards.

Provides essential details about the customer's current point balance and basic ownership information. Designed for use in general listing or overview contexts without exposing detailed transaction or audit data.

Sensitive fields and audit metadata are excluded.

All relationships are represented by identifiers or summary references as applicable.

id.description: Primary key identifier of the point record.

balance.description: Current balance of loyalty points held by the customer.

shopping_mall_customer_id.description: Identifier of the customer owning this point balance.

id.description: Unique identifier for the product review.

shopping_mall_product_id.description: Identifier of the product being reviewed.

shopping_mall_customer_id.description: Identifier of the customer who wrote the review.

rating.description: Star rating given by the customer, typically 1 to 5 stars.

title.description: Short summary headline describing the review content.

body.description: Detailed textual review provided by the customer.

moderation_status.description: Current moderation status: pending, approved, rejected.

created_at.description: Review creation timestamp.

updated_at.description: Last modification timestamp of the review.

deleted_at.description: Soft deletion timestamp, null if not deleted.

IShoppingMallProductReview.ISummary.description:
Summary information for a product review submitted by a customer.

Includes review metadata such as rating, title, content, and moderation status.
Soft deletion status is indicated if applicable.

id.description: Unique identifier for the moderation record.

shopping_mall_product_review_id.description: Identifier of the product review being moderated.

shopping_mall_admin_id.description: Identifier of the admin who performed the moderation.

action.description: Moderation action taken, e.g., approved, rejected, flagged.

comment.description: Optional comment explaining the moderation decision.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the moderation action was performed.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last update on this moderation record.

deleted_at.description: Soft deletion timestamp, null if not deleted.

IShoppingMallReviewModeration.ISummary.description:
Summary information for a moderation record associated with a product review.

Includes metadata such as action taken, optional comments, and timestamps.
Soft deletion status is indicated if applicable.

IShoppingMallCustomerQuestion.ISummary.description:
Summary view of a customer question related to shopping mall products and orders.

Provides essential information about the question including its title, creation date, and references to the customer who asked it without exposing sensitive session information.

Used for listing questions in customer support and Q&A views.

id.description: Unique identifier of the question.

title.description: The title or summary of the question content.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the question was created.

shopping_mall_customer_id.description: Reference ID of the customer who asked the question.

IShoppingMallQuestionAnswer.ISummary.description:
Summary view of an answer provided by sellers to customer questions in the shopping mall.

Contains the core information about the answer including title and creation timestamp, along with references to the question being answered and the seller who provided the answer.

Used for displaying seller responses in the Q&A interface with necessary relation context.

id.description: Unique identifier of the answer.

title.description: The title or headline of the answer.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the answer was created.

shopping_mall_customer_question_id.description: Reference ID of the customer question answered.

shopping_mall_seller_id.description: Reference ID of the seller who answered the question.

IShoppingMallSupportTicket.ISummary.description:
Summary of a customer or seller support ticket within the shopping mall platform.

This schema provides a concise overview of the support ticket, including its unique identifier, summarized title of the issue, current status such as open or resolved, and important timestamps showing creation and last update times.

Primarily used for presenting support tickets in list views and quick summaries for customer service representatives and internal tracking.

id.description: Unique identifier of the support ticket as a UUID string.

title.description: Brief summary or subject line of the support ticket describing the issue.

status.description: Current status of the support ticket, indicating its progress state such as 'open', 'in_progress', 'resolved', or 'closed'.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 formatted timestamp indicating when the support ticket was initially created.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 formatted timestamp indicating the last time the support ticket details were updated.

IShoppingMallRole.ISummary.description:
Concise summary representation of a system role within the shopping mall platform.

This schema includes the role's unique primary key id, internal name used for permissions checks, and a human-readable label describing the role's purpose.

It supports role display and selection in user interfaces such as drop-down menus and administrative role assignment screens.

id.description: Unique identifier primary key for the role entity, formatted as a UUID.

name.description: Unique internal name representing the role used in access control checks.

label.description: Readable label intended to describe the role's purpose and scope for display in user interfaces.

IShoppingMallPermission.ISummary.description:
Summary representation of a permission within the shopping mall backend system.

Includes essential identification and descriptive fields needed to understand permission intent and scope.

Primarily used for listing and embedding permission data in roles or users.

id.description: Unique identifier of the permission.

name.description: Unique internal identifier used to represent the permission in the system.

label.description: Human-readable label for the permission, suitable for display in user interfaces.

description.description: Detailed description elaborating the purpose and scope of this permission. May be null if unavailable.

created_at.description: The date and time when this permission was initially created.

updated_at.description: The date and time when this permission was last updated.

IShoppingMallAdminAuditLog.ISummary.description:
Summary representation of shopping mall administrator audit logs.

Provides essential information about administrative actions including the acting administrator's identifier, type of action, resource affected, success status, and creation timestamp. This summary is designed for efficient display in lists and audit views.

Sensitive details such as full action details are excluded for brevity.

id.description: Unique identifier of the audit log entry.

shopping_mall_admin_id.description: Identifier of the administrator who performed the action.

action_type.description: Type of action performed by the admin (e.g., CREATE_USER, DELETE_PRODUCT).

resource_type.description: The category of resource affected by the admin action, such as user, product, or order.

success.description: Indicates whether the action was successful.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the audit log was created.

IShoppingMallMvShoppingMallDailySale.ISu.description:
Summary of daily sales for the shopping mall platform.

Provides key metrics including sales date, total number of orders, total sales amount, and total items sold in a summarized form suitable for reporting and analytics dashboards.

As a read-only materialized view, this summary reflects a snapshot of aggregate sales data optimized for quick retrieval and display.

id.description: Unique identifier of the daily sales summary record.

sales_date.description: Date corresponding to the sales report, formatted according to ISO 8601 standards.

total_orders.description: Total number of orders placed on the reporting sales date.

total_sales_amount.description: Aggregated total sales amount in currency units for the day.

total_items_sold.description: Total count of items sold across all orders on the sales date.

IShoppingMallMvShoppingMallInventoryStat.description:
Represents a summary view of the current inventory status within the shopping mall categorized by product category.

This summary provides quick insights into SKU counts, total available inventory, low stock alerts, and the last refresh timestamp for monitoring and operational decision-making.

Each instance corresponds to a product category's inventory snapshot.

id.description: Primary key unique to individual inventory status records.

category_id.description: Identifier of the product category this inventory summary record belongs to.

total_sku_count.description: Total number of distinct SKUs under the product category.

total_inventory_quantity.description: Aggregate quantity of all SKU items available in stock within the category.

low_stock_threshold.description: SKU inventory level considered low stock threshold for alerting.

low_stock_sku_count.description: Number of SKUs currently below the low stock threshold within this category.

last_refreshed_at.description: Timestamp when this materialized view was last refreshed.

page.description: Page number for paginated results, starting at 1

limit.description: Number of items per page

search.description: Search keyword to filter products by name or description

categoryCode.description: Filter by category unique business identifier code

sellerCode.description: Filter by seller unique business identifier code

oneOf.description: Field by which to sort the results
Field by which to sort the results
Field by which to sort the results

sortBy.description: Field by which to sort the results

oneOf.description: Sort order: ascending or descending
Sort order: ascending or descending

inStockOnly.description: Whether to show only products that are in stock

includeDiscontinued.description: Whether to include discontinued products in the results

filter.description: Additional filter options for product attributes

categories.description: List of category codes to filter products

tags.description: List of tags to filter products

oneOf.description: Availability status filter
Availability status filter
Availability status filter

IShoppingMallProduct.IRequest.description: Search criteria and pagination parameters for filtering shopping mall products

IPageIShoppingMallWishlist.ISummary.description:
A page.

Collection of records with pagination information.

IShoppingMallGuest.ICreate.description: Data required to create a new shopping mall guest user record. Since all fields except the primary key and timestamps are managed by the system, the creation payload typically has no client-supplied fields. The server generates the unique identifier and manages timestamps automatically. This DTO is used when the system registers a new guest user session for anonymous browsing of the shopping mall platform.

IShoppingMallAdmin.ICreate.description:
Payload for creating a new shopping mall administrator account.

This DTO defines the input for administrator creation, including a unique email address and a plain text password, which the backend hashes and stores securely. System-generated fields such as id and timestamps are excluded.

Only authorized administrators can perform this operation.

Used as the request payload for the admin creation API.

email.description: Unique email address for the new administrator used for login and communication.

password.description: Plain text password for the new administrator account. The backend is responsible for hashing this password before storage.

IShoppingMallProduct.description:
Represents products offered for sale within the shopping mall platform.

Each product includes mandatory unique business code, title, optional detailed description, brand information, and a reference to the category it belongs to. Temporal tracking fields cover creation, last update, and soft deletion to maintain data integrity and history.

The category reference points to the shopping mall category entity, categorizing and organizing products into hierarchical groups.

This schema excludes any authentication or ownership fields as they are managed by system context and authorization layers.

id.description: Unique identifier of the product.

code.description: Unique product code for business identification.

title.description: Product title descriptive name.

description.description: Detailed product description for customers.

shopping_mall_category.description: The category to which this product belongs, providing classification and organization.

created_at.description: Record creation timestamp.

updated_at.description: Record last update timestamp.

deleted_at.description: Soft deletion timestamp; null if the product is active.

IShoppingMallProduct.ICreate.description:
Request body schema used to create a new shopping mall product.

Includes mandatory unique product code, title, and category_code for product classification.

Optional fields for detailed description and brand are supported.

Excluded are system-generated fields like id, timestamps, and ownership or authorization fields, which are handled by system context.

Clients must provide valid category_code correlating to an existing category.

Security filtering excludes any authentication or sensitive fields from input.

code.description: Unique product code for business identification.

title.description: Product title descriptive name.

description.description: Detailed product description for customers, optional.

category_code.description: Unique code of the category to which the product belongs, mapping to shopping_mall_categories.code.

IShoppingMallProduct.IUpdate.description: This schema defines the structure for updating an existing shopping mall product. It allows modification of product details such as title, description, brand, and category association. The update excludes immutable fields like ID and timestamps managed by the system. The productCode is used as a path parameter and therefore excluded from the body. Actor fields such as seller or admin ID are injected from authentication context and must not be included here.

title.description: The product's descriptive title which can be updated to reflect modified information or corrections.

description.description: Detailed description of the product for customer information. It is optional and can be set to null to clear the existing description.

brand.description: Brand or manufacturer name associated with the product, which can be updated or cleared.

shopping_mall_category_id.description: Reference ID to the associated product category. Must point to an existing category in the mall's product catalog.

IShoppingMallCart.ICreate.description:
Request payload for creating a new shopping mall cart by a customer. The owning customer identifier is excluded from the payload as it is derived from the authenticated user token. Optional session context can be provided to associate the cart with a specific browsing session. The API manages creation and update timestamps automatically. Soft deletion is not allowed via create.

Fields:
- shopping_mall_customer_session_id: optional UUID of the customer's session for tracking.

Security:
- shopping_mall_customer_id is removed as it is supplied by the server from authentication context.

Lifecycle fields (id, created_at, updated_at) are generated by the system and are not accepted from client input.

This input allows atomic creation of a new shopping cart tied to the authenticated customer.

shopping_mall_customer_session_id.description: Optional reference UUID to the customer's current session. Nullable to allow missing session context.

IShoppingMallCart.IUpdate.description: Secure request payload for updating an existing shopping mall cart. Removed authentication context fields to enforce zero-trust security model. Allows modification of session association only server-side. Retains soft deletion marking capability. System-managed timestamps are not client-controlled.

deleted_at.description: Optional nullable timestamp to set soft deletion status. A non-null value marks the cart as deleted.

IShoppingMallWishlist.IRequest.description:
Search criteria and pagination parameters for filtering shopping mall wishlists.

This specialized request schema enables clients to perform complex searches on wishlists owned by customers of the shopping mall platform. It supports filtering by owning customer, creation date ranges, and soft deletion status, along with typical pagination controls.

Clients use this schema as the request body in PATCH operations to retrieve filtered and paginated lists of wishlists. The schema is designed with security in mind, avoiding any sensitive or actor-identifying fields.

page.description: Page number for paginated results. Must be a positive integer starting from 1.

limit.description: Number of items per page for paginated results. Should be a positive integer with an upper limit to prevent overload.

created_at_from.description: Filter wishlists created at or after this date-time (ISO 8601 format).

created_at_to.description: Filter wishlists created before this date-time (ISO 8601 format).

include_deleted.description: Flag indicating whether to include soft-deleted wishlists in the results. If true, also returns wishlists with a non-null deleted_at timestamp.

IShoppingMallOrder.ICreate.description:
Create DTO for a shopping mall order entity.

This DTO is used by the authenticated customer to submit a new order.

The customer and seller IDs must not be provided by the client; they are injected from the authentication context.

Required fields include the unique order number, order & payment status, total amount, and shipping address.

Timestamps and IDs are system managed and must not be present.

order_number.description: Unique business reference number for the order used in tracking and management.

order_status.description: Initial lifecycle status of the order at creation.

payment_status.description: Initial payment state corresponding to this order.

total_amount.description: Total monetary amount for the entire order including taxes and shipping.

shipping_address.description: Serialized shipping address information captured at the time the order was placed.

IShoppingMallOrder.IUpdate.description:
Update DTO for a shopping mall order entity.

Allows modification of mutable fields such as order status, payment status, total amount, and shipping address.

Identifiers and ownership details cannot be updated.

All properties are optional to allow partial updates.

Timestamps are system managed and not present in this DTO.

order_status.description: Updated lifecycle status of the order.

payment_status.description: Updated payment state for this order.

total_amount.description: Updated total monetary amount, including taxes and shipping.

IShoppingMallSupportTicket.ICreate.description:
Payload for creating a new support ticket in the ShoppingMall platform.

Allows customers or sellers to submit detailed issue reports or requests including the title, description, and sets initial status.
Session identifiers are omitted when not provided but typically captured server-side.
User identity fields related to submitter are excluded, as they are derived from authentication context.

title.description: Subject or summary of the support ticket issue or request.

description.description: Detailed explanation of the issue or support request provided by the submitter.

status.description: Initial status of the support ticket upon creation. Typically set to 'open' or other allowed state.

IShoppingMallSupportTicket.IUpdate.description:
Payload for updating an existing support ticket in the ShoppingMall platform.

Provides modifiable properties including title, description, and status.
Ownership and session identifiers are immutable and excluded from updates.
Timestamps are managed automatically and should not be included.

title.description: Updated subject or summary of the support ticket.

description.description: Updated detailed explanation of the issue or request.

status.description: Updated status reflecting the current progress or resolution state of the ticket.

IShoppingMallWishlist.ISummary.description:
Summary representation of a customer's wishlist in the shopping mall system.

Provides essential details about the wishlist without including nested item details.
Includes the unique identifier, the owning customer reference, and timestamps reflecting creation, update, and soft deletion.

This summary is suitable for list views and reference contexts where full wishlist data is not required.

id.description: Unique identifier for the wishlist.

shopping_mall_customer_id.description: Identifier of the customer who owns this wishlist.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the wishlist was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the wishlist was last updated.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the wishlist was soft deleted; null if active.
